Hollywood and the racing community are revving up to once again gear up for F1 Miami Grand Prix.

Page Six will be on-site at the Miami International Autodrome and nearby hotspots to bring you the inside scoop on all the celeb sightings from race weekend, which is taking place May 2 to 4.

However, if you’re flying down to Florida for the big event or are already in the Sunshine State, here is a full guide to all the best places to eat, play and stay for F1 Miami — as well as where to catch the big race.

[![Image 1: The F1 Miami Grand Prix.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/general-view-start-f1-grand-102834862.jpg)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

The F1 Miami Grand Prix will return for its fourth year in South Florida. Formula 1 via Getty Images

[![Image 2: Kendall Jenner.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/kendall-jenner-looks-pitlane-prior-102887047.jpg)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

A-listers like Kendall Jenner have been spotted at F1 Miami in the past. Getty Images

WHERE TO WATCH F1 MIAMI:
------------------------

### Miami International Autodrome

The Formula 1 Crypto.com Miami Grand Prix, hosted by South Florida Motorsports, will be back for its fourth year in a row at the Miami International Autodrome in Miami Gardens, Fla., on May 4.

The home of the Miami Dolphins will be transformed into a 19-turn, 3.36-mile track within the complex of Hard Rock Stadium, which will feature stations from dozens of vendors, including drinks from Magic City’s craft brewery Cerveceria La Tropical, the exclusive social club Fabel Miami, Mexican street food by Bodega Taqueria y Tequila, Bondi Sushi, Miami Slice for pizza lovers and so much more.

On the race track, [qualifying drivers](https://f1miamigp.com/f1-drivers/?srsltid=AfmBOooKQZu5ETR5RutTmx2Jni6_Uj4uGpzmc1EJB463G1-gOKCOKlRQ) from Alpine, McLaren, Ferrari, Red Bull Racing, Mercedes, Aston Martin, MoneyGram, Racing Bulls, Williams Racing and Kick Sauber are set to compete at 4 p.m. ET.

[![Image 3: Miami International Autodrome in Miami Gardens, Fla.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/view-track-celebrity-friends-f1-102834011.jpg)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

F1 Miami will once again be held at the Miami International Autodrome in Miami Gardens, Fla. Getty Images for Raising Cane's

[![Image 4: The Jonas Brothers posing with team members from Alpine.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/bwt-alpine-f1-team-esteban-10793438.jpg)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

Celebrities are known for heading down to Miami for the races. Chris DuMond/Shutterstock

### Tala Beach

Oceanfront restaurant and bar [Tala Beach](https://www.1hotels.com/south-beach/taste/tala-beach), located at 2341 Collins Ave in South Beach, is hosting a Formula 1 Miami watch-party from 3 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET on May 4. Guests will be treated to handcrafted cocktails, live grill stations and a high-energy DJ set from 3 p.m. to 4 p.m.

[![Image 5: Talia Beach.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/Tala-Beach-3.jpg)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

Racing fans who can’t make it to the Miami International Autodrome, can catch a viewing party at Tala Beach. Talia Beach

[![Image 6: Drivers racing.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/oracle-red-bull-racing-rb19-102834899.jpg)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

The big race is scheduled to take place on May 4. Getty Images

WHERE TO EAT:
-------------

### a’Riva at Harbour Club

[a’Riva at Harbour Club](https://www.harbourclubmia.com/ariva) — having just opened its doors in 2024 — is celebrating its first F1 Miami with a sophisticated menu led by Chef Michele Esposito, formerly of Casa Tua, Belmond Hotel Caruso and three Michelin-starred Villa Crespi. Its menu highlights seasonal Italian flavors and Mediterranean influences.

### American Social Bar and Kitchen

[American Social Bar and Kitchen](https://americansocialbar.com/locations/miami/), which has numerous locations in the South Florida area, will be featuring a special lineup of handcrafted cocktails designed just for F1. From the bold Checkered Past to the tropical Mr. Miami Hai or the spicy kick of the jalapeño-infused Hot Lap margarita, every drink is crafted for champions.

[![Image 7: People cheering at American Social Bar and Kitchen.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/Sports-Cover.jpg)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

American Social Bar and Kitchen will feature a special drink menu inspired by F1. American Social Bar and Kitchen.

### Bouchon

Located in Coral Gables, Bouchon is a French restaurant with meals by award-winning Chef Keller. Blackboard specials for F1 weekend will feature a white asparagus salad and braised lamb shoulder.

### Catch Miami Beach

Located in the South of Fifth neighborhood, this hotspot is known for its globally-influenced menu of renditions on the best seafood, sushi and steak classics alongside excellent service and a lively vibe.

### Casadonna

[Casadonna](https://casadonnamiami.com/), the coastal Italian restaurant and lounge from Groot Hospitality and Tao Group Hospitality, is hosting an exclusive Race Day Brunch Buffet on May 4 from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. ET.

For $98 a person, guests will enjoy a luxurious al fresco dining experience complete with live music, sweeping waterfront views and a menu inspired by the Italian coast. They will also be treated with a two-hour beverage package, featuring champagne, wine and signature cocktails.

[![Image 8: Casodonna.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/Casadonna-Brunch-Credit_-Casadonna.jpg)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

Casadonna is hosting a Race Day Brunch Buffet. Casadonna.

### Chase Sapphire Reserve Experience

Chase Sapphire Reserve cardmembers can access complimentary apps by Chef Sebastian Benitez and a cash bar — plus one complimentary drink — from inside the Miami International Autodrome May 2 to May 4. However, time slots must be booked in advance, with a maximum of two slots available per day.

### Giselle Miami

From May 2 to May 4, [this trendy fusion restaurant](https://gisellemiami.com/) located in downtown Miami is offering a limited edition Formula 1-inspired menu, including dishes like Madai carpaccio, lobster and caviar rolls, F1 flaming surf and turf, and cocktails aptly titled Pole Position, Grand Prix and more.

### Hell’s Kitchen Miami

[Hell’s Kitchen Miami](https://www.gordonramsayrestaurants.com/en/us/hells-kitchen) is hosting a special five-course dinner series led by “Hell’s Kitchen” Season 21 winner Alex Belew, who is also having a meet-and-greet, complete with signed menus on May 2.

Gordon Ramsay’s upscale restaurant will also feature a Grand Prix brunch on May 3 and 4 from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. that will include DJ sets, delicious cocktails, an F1® car photo-op and display of iconic race-day steering wheels and championship trophies.

[![Image 9: Gordon Ramsay.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/photo-dave-benett-getty-images-99381738.jpg?w=717)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

Gordon Ramsay’s Hells Kitchen Miami restaurant is hosting a special F1 menu. Dave Benett/Getty Images for Gordon Ramsay Restaurants

### Joia Beach

[Joia Beach Restaurant and Beach Club](https://joiabeachmiami.com/) on Watson Island is partnering with Moët & Chandon, the official Champagne of Formula 1, for a celebration that features specialty pairings, such as Moët & Chandon Impérial Brut with french fries or Ice Impérial with sorbet from May 3 until after the big race on May 26.

[![Image 10: Joia Beach.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/Joia-Beach-The-Beach-Club-Credit_-Joia-Beach.jpg)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

Joia Beach has partnered with Moët & Chandon, the official Champagne for Formula 1, for specialty drinks. Joia Beach.

### La Grande Boucherie

Another hotspot in the South of Fifth neighborhood is the [La Grande Boucherie](https://www.boucherieus.com/), an immersive dining destination that combines French culinary tradition with the lush, garden-inspired ambiance of Miami. Guests can indulge in a menu crafted by Executive Chef Leonardo Pablo, featuring both classic French dishes and modern twists.

### **Lucky Cat Miami**

For $150, celebrity chef Ramsay’s [Lucky Cat Miami](https://www.gordonramsayrestaurants.com/en/us/lucky-cat) is offering all race weekend long — from May 2 to May 4 — a Grand Prix-inspired five-course tasting menu, DJ sets and displays from Ferrari and Red Bull’s racing teams. On May 3, there will also be a special art installation and live walkthrough from British F1 sculptor Paul Oz at 6 p.m., followed by an intimate Q&A with world champion Mika Häkkinen.

### The Joyce and The Window at The Joyce

This restaurant and its laidback outdoor café on the lively Española Way in Miami, which is [a favorite of influencer Alix Earle](https://pagesix.com/2025/03/03/celebrity-news/bethenny-frankel-alix-earle-make-amends-at-private-dinner/), combines the classics of a Chicago-style steakhouse with standout dishes like King Crab Scampi, Caviar Latkes, expertly crafted burgers and a curated selection of steaks.

[![Image 11: Bethenny Frankel and Alix Earle.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/influencer-alix-earle-wears-sheer-99565451.jpg?w=683)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

Alix Earle was recently spotted eating at The Joyce with Bethenny Frankel. MEGA

### Mother Wolf

[Mother Wolf Miami](https://www.motherwolfmiami.com/) is a culinary gem nestled within Miami’s Design District. Whether indulging in a classic cacio e pepe, sipping carefully curated cocktails or exploring the extensive wine list, this restaurant offers a sophisticated dining destination that transports guests to the streets of Rome.

### Mimi Chinese Miami

[Mimi Chinese](https://mimichinese.com/miami/), the Michelin-starred Chinese cuisine, has partnered with luxe tequila brand Clase Azul for an exclusive dining experience for F1 Miami 2025 beginning April 29 through May 4. Guests will indulge in a custom tasting menu will include signature Mimi Chinese selections from shrimp toast, hunan chili seabass, supreme fried rice and more. Reservations are recommended.

[![Image 12: Mimi Chinese.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/MIMI-Chinese-Interior-Photo-Credit-Daniel-Neuhaus4.jpg)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

Mimi Chinese is partnering with Clase Azul for an exclusive F1 dining experience. Daniel Neuhaus

### Queen Miami Beach

[Queen Miami Beach](https://queenmiamibeach.com/), which reimagines the historic Paris Theater in South Beach as a lavish two-story Japanese steakhouse, delivers an ingredient-focused culinary experience by Chef Christopher Robert alongside a breathtaking setting.

### Sexy Fish Miami

[Sexy Fish Miami](https://sexyfishmiami.com/), a Japanese-inspired restaurant, is hosting a thrilling dining experience that will make for an unforgettable race week. DJ Julian OK and DJ WAAE will ensure their sets fuel the energy in the room Thursday, May 1 through Sunday, May 4, alongside fire performers, stilt walkers and jaw-dropping visuals. Last year, Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes were [spotted “canoodling”](https://pagesix.com/2024/05/04/entertainment/patrick-and-brittany-mahomes-party-at-sexy-fish-ahead-of-f1-miami-grand-prix/) at this sexy spot.

[![Image 13: Brittany Mahomes taking a mirror selfie with friends.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/brittany-mahomes-miami-2024-103299912.jpg?w=700)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

Brittany Mahomes enjoyed herself at Sexy Fish Miami for F1 Miami 2024 with her gal pals and husband Patrick Mahomes. brittanylynne/Instagram

WHERE TO PLAY:
--------------

### Hard Rock Beach Club

Hard Rock International, a founding partner of the Formula 1 Crypto.com Miami Grand Prix, is bringing back the [Hard Rock Beach Club](https://f1miamigp.com/tickets/club/beach-club/) to give racing aficionados a full day club experience. Dance music superstars Kygo and Cedric Gervais will kick off performances on May 2, Kaskade and Sofi Tukker will perform May 3, Tiesto and Justin Quiles will do special pre-race sets and Mr. 305 himself, Pitbull, will hit the stage on May 4. King Bell is set to sing the National Anthem at the race.

[![Image 14: Hard Rock International.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/www-instagram-com-p-dibl045vgdw-102834311.jpg)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

Hard Rock International is a founding partner of the Formula 1 Crypto.com Miami Grand Prix. hardrockholly/Instagram

[![Image 15: Pitbull performing.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/pitbull-performs-o2-arena-party-98954801.jpg)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

Pitbull is set to perform at the Hard Rock Beach Club on May 4. Getty Images

### Harbour Club’s VIP experience at the track

For $10,000 a ticket, the Harbour Club is giving its VIP guests a three-day pass to the race track, featuring prime views and next-level dining courtesy of a’Riva and Nikai — including Chef Michele’s famed gelato.

The private sofa box seating is located within the stadium and guests will also have access to the air-conditioned lounge. Food and service are all-inclusive. A black service car will also be provided to and from the Hard Rock Stadium, as well as a bonus tour of the Paddock Village.

Contact [nickie@harbourclubmia.com](mailto:nickie@harbourclubmia.com) to make arrangements.

### 2025 F1 Crypto.com Miami Grand Prix® track preview experience and Paddock tour

On May 1, Chase Sapphire Reserve will host an exclusive preview event at the Miami Autodrome from 4:30 to 8:30 p.m. ET, giving fans and cardmembers VIP access to the track ahead of the weekend.

### American Express presents: Carbone Beach

The most exclusive party ticket in town is returning courtesy of Major Food Group and American Express.

The “Supper Club on The Sand,” which features delicious cuisines curated by Mario Carbone, [a star-studded guest list](https://pagesix.com/2024/05/06/entertainment/inside-travis-kelces-solo-night-out-at-f1-miami-grand-prix/) and impressive rolodex of surprise performances will take place May 2 to May 4.

[![Image 16: Lauren Sanchez and Jeff Bezos at Carbone Beach.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/lauren-sanchez-pictured-leaving-gipsy-10754410.jpg?w=563)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

Several A-listers are expected to hit up the exclusive Carbone Beach party. LCD / SplashNews.com

The lavish dinner party, which costs about [$3,000-a-head](https://pagesix.com/2022/04/20/carbone-charging-3k-a-head-for-miami-grand-prix-dinner-party/), always boasts luxe decor, great entertainment and A-list sightings. Travis Kelce [had a solo night out](https://pagesix.com/2024/05/06/entertainment/inside-travis-kelces-solo-night-out-at-f1-miami-grand-prix/) — sans girlfriend Taylor Swift — at last year’s event.

Tickets are available at [CarboneBeach.com](https://urldefense.com/v3/__http://carbonebeach.com/__;!!F0Stn7g!HR6Lhdx88fXXzeDD0NKIdSjdGrmJtomUDz7WJi53Oi34XVcCyHGh37otp80eIw2e8jbKuSPKpBSmcwjj$).

### Delilah Miami’s dinner and a show

[Delilah Miami](https://www.delilahrestaurants.com/location/miami/), the vintage-inspired venue located in Brickell, will host a star-studded lineup of celebrity performances for F1 weekend. Timbaland is set to hit the stage at the American cuisine restaurant for a special race week edition of Throwback Thursdays on May 1.

Hip-hop legend Fat Joe will then perform May 2 and Sofi Tukker will give an an electrifying DJ set May 3. For the big race, on May 4, Delilah will host a brunch soundtracked by a live jazz band to help recharge the engines. The festivities will be capped off with an “After the Race” dinner, featuring a surprise guest.

### E11EVEN Miami

The iconic 24-hour ultraclub, which recently [celebrated its 11-year anniversary](https://pagesix.com/2025/01/29/lifestyle/e11even-miami-celebrates-11-years-with-club-secrets/), is one of Miami’s go-to late-night spots for the F1 Grand Prix weekend. E11EVEN, which Mayor Eric Adams is even [pining to bring up to the Big Apple](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/07/society/eric-adams-wants-to-bring-miamis-mega-club-e11even-to-nyc/), has a star-studded set of performances planned all race weekend long.

Diplo is set to hit the club’s stage on May 1, followed by early aughts hip-hop superstars Nelly on May 2 and 50 Cent on May 3, along with EDM favorite AfroJack finishing off the performance list on May 4.

[![Image 17: 50 Cent performing.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/rapper-50-cent-performs-vendome-99084613.jpg)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

50 Cent is among the performers set to hit the stage at E11EVEN. ExclusiveAccess.Net/Shutterstock

### LIV Miami

LIV, David Grutman’s premier nightclub inside of the Fontainebleau Miami Beach hotel, is kicking off its race weekend on May 1 with Black Coffee, followed by John Summit on May 2 and a special edition of “LIV on Sunday,” the No. 1 hip-hop party in Magic City, on May 4.

[![Image 18: John Summit.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/house-techno-dj-john-summit-98130793.jpg?w=1024)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

John Summit will do a DJ set at LIV on May 2. Getty Images

### Racing Fan Fest

The largest off-track fan experience during Miami Race Week 2025 is back. [Racing Fan Fest](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/racing-fan-fest-largest-off-track-fan-festival-during-miami-race-week-tickets-1256768130309?aff=ebdssbdestsearch) is a free event that offers a thrilling mix of live entertainment, the Red Bull Pit Stop Challenge, racing simulators, formally raced cars, virtual reality installations, delicious bites and cocktails, live DJ sets and exclusive sponsor gifts and merchandise. It’s taking place from May 1 to May 4 at the Wynwood Marketplace.

[![Image 19: Race winner Lando Norris.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/race-winner-lando-norris-great-102887065.jpg)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

Racing Fan Fest is offering a thrilling mix of live entertainment at the Wynwood Marketplace. Getty Images

### McLaren Track Driving Experience

In partnership with Chase Auto and auto partner McLaren, Chase Sapphire Reserve cardmembers can access an off-the-track driving experience with world-class driving coaches on April 30 from 8 a.m. to 12 p.m. The event will take place at Concours Club Miami, One Concours Way, Opa-locka, FL 33054.

### **Supercar Showdown 4.0**

Supercar Showdown 4.0 — an immersive, six-day celebration of luxury automobiles, fashion, and entertainment designed for automotive enthusiasts, collectors, and lifestyle connoisseurs — presented by Supercar Rooms and Vice City District is taking place April 29 through May 4.

This one-of-a-kind event will feature a curated supercar rally, high-end fashion activations, private dinners and exclusive nightlife experiences throughout Miami and at the track. Tickets, which are [available for purchase here,](https://www.supercarrooms.com/) will also provide VIP access to F1 Qualifying and Race Day at Hard Rock Beach Club.

[![Image 20: Cars lined up.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/3f7a9a6b-1525-44f7-a69c-296deaa67d24.jpg)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

A special event for car aficionados is taking place during F1 Miami 2025. Supercar Rooms

### ‘F1 Academy’ Documentary Series US premiere, presented by Amex

On May 1, Amex invites its card members to an exclusive evening at [The Fillmore](https://www.instagram.com/fillmoremb/?hl=en) in Miami Beach to celebrate the US premiere of Netflix and Hello Sunshine’s “F1 Academy” docuseries. The event will feature an early screening of the first episode, a panel discussion with executives from the F1 Academy, Hello Sunshine and American Express, as well as a live musical performance from Young Miko. Tickets are [available for purchase](https://www.ticketmaster.com/event/0D006289C386308F) for $25 for American Express card members starting April 16.

### Driven Artists Racing Team (DART Car) x Mickalene Thomas debuts in Miami Design District

The world of motorsport and contemporary art will come together for Driven Artists Racing Team (DART Car)— a mission-driven, female-led motorsports team— for the debut of their McLaren Artura GT4 race car wrapped in original artwork by acclaimed artist Mickalene Thomas.

Racing fans can catch a peek of the one-of-a-kind art car on May 2 at The Moore and then Paradise Plaza from May 3 to May 4. Thomas will also be on-site with the exclusive pieces available for purchase.

[![Image 21: Mickalene Thomas.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/4.-Mickalene-Thomas-behind-helmets-created-by-Thomas_Image-courtesy-of-Kelsey-H-Campbell-Photography.jpg)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

Mickalene Thomas will debut her new race car artwork during F1 Miami weekend. Kelsey H. Campbell Photography

### Marion Miami’s Soirée during F1 weekend

[Marion](https://www.marionmiami.com/), located in the heart of Brickell, is kicking off F1 weekend with a special performance by Joezi, the globally celebrated Afro-house artist known for his soulful sound, uplifting rhythms and immersive sets.

### CELSIUS’ pop-up at Palm Tree Club Miami

On May 2, popular energy drink brand CELSIUS is hosting a pop-up at Palm Tree Club Miami in North Bay Village. Swedish House Mafia member DJ Sebastian Ingrosso will kickstart the vibes. Guests can also expect unique photo moments and CELSIUS mocktails to be served.

### Bonhams|Cars Miami Auction

On May 3, after the qualifying race, [Bonhams|Cars](https://www.bonhams.com/) will host an exclusive auction in front of a live audience of registered bidders and their guests on the southside of the Hard Rock Stadium.

Rare memorabilia items, including race-worn helmets and overalls, from some of Formula 1’s greatest drivers, including five world Champions, will be up for bidding in the auction.

[![Image 22: The Hard Rock Stadium.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/www-instagram-com-p-dibl045vgdw-102834313.jpg)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

Bonhams|Cars is hosting an exclusive auction on the southside of the Hard Rock Stadium. hardrockholly/Instagram

The sale is headlined by one of Formula 1’s most legendary machines, the groundbreaking 2009 Brawn GP Chassis 001/01, in addition to a rare 2022 Lamborghini Countach LPI 800-4, a 1990 Porsche 911 Classic Turbo Reimagined by Singer and a collection of 13 modern sports cars in shades of orange.

WHERE TO STAY:
--------------

### Four Seasons Hotel and Residences Fort Lauderdale

The [Four Seasons Hotel and Residences Fort Lauderdale](https://www.fourseasons.com/fortlauderdale/), located 20 miles from the Miami International Autodrome, provides its guests with a peaceful oasis in which to wind down after the race.

The hotel blends oceanfront luxury with a sleek, yacht-inspired aesthetic, where guests can reset with restorative treatments at [The Spa](https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://www.fourseasons.com/fortlauderdale/spa/?utm_source=google&utm_medium=organicsearch&utm_campaign=tor-ftl-spa-mid-seo-na&utm_content=na-na&utm_term=na__;!!F0Stn7g!GzvSxhEAuGbhm4gtgg7Q5ick3JrxOApukZuCRPfTxu2CTORx8y6NvDHNEqtjas-_Q2sERg11pocwDcw$), relax in a cabana at the hotel’s horizon-edge pools or enjoy handcrafted cocktails and coastal mediterranean bites at [Evelyn’s](https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://www.fourseasons.com/fortlauderdale/dining/restaurants/evelyns/__;!!F0Stn7g!GzvSxhEAuGbhm4gtgg7Q5ick3JrxOApukZuCRPfTxu2CTORx8y6NvDHNEqtjas-_Q2sERg11fUubC4c$).

For those looking to turn race weekend into a getaway, the hotel has an [advance purchase offer](https://www.fourseasons.com/fortlauderdale/offers/?c=t&cm_ven=ExactTarget&jobid=2895526&cm_cat=Multi_AMER_FTL_MIA_Mar13_2025&cm_ite=Offer2_CTA&cid=RzE4RjgyODAyMUMzMTRFRDc3MTE=&testver=Param_1&pc=&creg=USWest&seg=NA) that allows guests to save up to 20 percent on stays when booked early, with starting rates at $599 per night.

[![Image 23: Four Seasons Hotel.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/BE5F53AA-A830-44D1-BA7B-8434D6451039.jpg)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

The Four Seasons Hotel in Fort Lauderdale is 20 miles from the Miami International Autodrome, where the race is held. Four Seasons Hotel.

###  Gale Miami Hotel and Residences

The [Gale Miami Hotel and Residences](https://www.galehotelmiami.com/) in downtown Miami is located just 25 minutes from the track and has easy access to the beach and nightlife. You can use code SUITE to get 30 percent off on your stay.

### The Diplomat Beach Resort

The [Diplomat Beach Resort](https://www.diplomatresort.com/), located along the beaches of Hollywood, Fla., is just a short drive away from the high-speed action at Hard Rock Stadium. From May 1 to May 4, the resort will offer Grand Prix-themed experiences. Test your skills on the McLaren F1 team simulator experience and refuel at the custom Jack Daniel’s Tennessee Whiskey Bar serving signature cocktails, sampling and giveaways.

### The Setai Miami Beach Hotel

The [Setai Miami Beach Hotel](https://www.thesetaihotel.com/), one of the leading hotels in the world, boasts a five-star award from Forbes and two Michelin keys. Designed by Jean-Michel Gathy and Jaya Ibrahim, it has the inviting essence of Asian hospitality with unparalleled personalized service. Chefs Vijayudu Veena and Iván Monzón elevated the hotel’s South Asian allure with the opening of Japón and Jaya and Ocean Grill.

[![Image 24: The Setai Miami Beach.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/04/The-Setai-Miami-Beach.jpeg)](https://pagesix.com/2025/04/18/entertainment/f1-miami-2025-guide-on-where-to-eat-play-and-stay-for-the-grand-prix/# "Open a slideshow of all 24 article images.")

The Setai Miami Beach offers an oceanside escape during the F1 Miami Grand Prix. The Setai Miami Beach.

### The St. Regis Bal Harbour

The St. Regis Bal Harbour, where every room offers unobstructed ocean views and spacious private balconies, is set along on Collins Avenue and just a short drive from the Miami Grand Prix circuit.

Through May 11, guests can shop the exclusive [STAUD x St. Regis](https://event.marriott.com/miaxr-the-st-regis-bal-harbour-resort/events/bal-harbour/staud-x-the-st-regis-bal-harbour--resort-capsule-collection?dates=Apr%2013,%202025) capsule collection for raffia and embossed leather accessories made for poolside champagne hours. The resort also features Greek-inspired dishes at Atlantikós, all-day dining at La Gourmandise and handcrafted cocktails at the elegant St. Regis Bar, as well as a 14,000 square-foot spa with treatments like the 24K Gold Age Defying Wrap.

### Want more celebrity and pop culture news?

Start your day with Page Six Daily.

### Thanks for signing up!

### The Moore Miami Hotel

The first and only hotel in Magic City’s Design District, [the Moore Miami Hotel](https://www.mooremiami.com/), is a boutique retreat that offers just 15 uniquely curated suites, each ranging from 700 to 1,000 square feet. Amenities include The Rabbit Hole speakeasy, The Club restaurant, a library, karaoke and game rooms.

Art Basel Miami Beach is back and bigger than ever.

Art Week in the coastal Floridian city is known for attracting some of the most celebrities, including Leonardo DiCaprio, Kim Kardashian, 50 Cent and Cardi B. Many of them famously [](https://pagesix.com/2022/12/03/leonardo-dicaprio-kim-kardashian-hit-wayne-boichs-art-basel-bash/)attended Wayne and Cynthia Boich’s [star-studded soirée last year.](https://pagesix.com/2022/12/03/leonardo-dicaprio-kim-kardashian-hit-wayne-boichs-art-basel-bash/)

[![Image 1: 50 Cent. ](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2023/11/travis-scott-50-cent-perform-73044961.jpg?w=683)](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2023/11/travis-scott-50-cent-perform-73044961.jpg "Open a slideshow of all 10 article images.")

Last year, 50 Cent performed at a star-studded private mansion party. Getty Images

Take a look at all the parties and events that are rolling out the red carpet for Hollywood stars, art world insiders, influencers and more this year.

Capital One’s dinner party series
---------------------------------

### Wednesday, Dec. 6 – Thursday, Dec. 7

[![Image 2: José Andrés ](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2023/11/2023-chef-jose-andres-captured-61865706.jpg?w=1024)](https://pagesix.com/2023/12/03/society/art-basel-miami-2023-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 10 article images.")

José Andrés will partake in Capital One’s dinner party series. Getty Images for Atlantis The Royal

Capital One has commissioned an installation with artist Alex Israel and The Cultivist, a global arts club.

Israel will also team up with Michelin-starred chefs José Andrés and Dominique Crenn to put on a series of pop-up events focused on food.

Crenn will host a cardholder-exclusive dinner on the evening of Dec. 6, Andrés will host one on Dec. 7 and Israel will debut his “Snow Beach Frozen Treats” installation — a pop-up frozen yogurt shop inspired by the artist’s childhood in Los Angeles with a nod to nostalgia — to the public on Dec. 8.

Tribeca Festival at Art Basel Miami Beach
-----------------------------------------

### Wednesday, Dec. 6 – Saturday, Dec. 9

[![Image 3: John Stamos. ](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2023/11/john-stamos-visits-siriusxms-the-62379116.jpg?w=1024)](https://pagesix.com/2023/12/03/society/art-basel-miami-2023-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 10 article images.")

John Stamos will sit for a fireside chat with Tribeca Film Festival at Art Basel Miami. Getty Images for SiriusXM

Tribeca Festival and Art Basel announced the lineup for Talks for Tribeca Festival at Art Basel Miami Beach taking place Dec. 6 to Dec. 9.

The event features four nights of exclusive conversations at the Miami Beach Botanical Garden with headliners including Robert De Niro and John Stamos.

There will also be live performances by artists including Eartheater, Dangerous Rose, Actress and Takuya Nakamura.

Ross+Kramer Miami Gallery Opening with Exhibition by Daniel Arsham
------------------------------------------------------------------

### Thursday, Dec. 7

Ross+Kramer Gallery is opening its Miami location and will celebrate with an invite-only grand opening party during Art Week on Dec. 7.

The fête will showcase an exciting new exhibition by artist Daniel Arsham titled “Miami 3023.”

Liv Miami celebrates Basel
--------------------------

### Wednesday, Dec. 6 – Saturday, Dec. 9

Nightclub Liv Miami has a stellar line-up of performers to celebrate the annual art fair.

Talen set to hit the DJ booth include Sofi Tukker, Tïesto, John Summit, and Kaytranada Rampa.

 Bluprint by ArtRepublic x WHY 
-------------------------------

### Thursday, Dec. 7

Bluprint is teaming up with Chef Todd English for an event at Waldorf Astoria Residences.

The chef has curated a menu of savory cuisines and refreshing cocktails, including spicy drinks made with Ghost Tequila.

Art After Dark at COTE Miami
----------------------------

### Thursday, Dec. 7

Renowned private collectors including Amanita, Artline, Craig Robins, Henry Buhl, John Marquez, Miyoung Lee and Reilly Opelka will reunite to showcase their world-class pieces at Michelin-starred and James Beard-nominated COTE Miami.

The exhibit, in partnership with Artline, focuses on “Relationships” and will launch with a VIP cocktail party on Dec. 7.

Maxim Miami Art Week Party at Hyde Beach
----------------------------------------

### Saturday, Dec. 9

[![Image 4: Cardi B in Miami.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2023/11/offset-cardi-b-seen-e11even-73044951.jpg?w=1024)](https://pagesix.com/2023/12/03/society/art-basel-miami-2023-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 10 article images.")

Cardi B attended Maxim’s party in 2021. Getty Images for E11EVEN

Maxim is hosting its fifth annual Art Week party with DJ James Hype at Hyde Beach at SLS South Beach on Dec. 9.

The star-studded poolside soirée will feature a performance by a surprise artist and a collaboration with another yet-to-be-revealed performer.

Haute Living Art Week
---------------------

### Thursday, Dec. 7- Friday, Dec. 8

Haute Living is throwing three big events this year. On Dec. 7, the magazine will celebrate cover star JR with an intimate gallery viewing at Perrotin and dinner at Swan Miami.

That same night, Haute Living and The Macallan are teaming up to host an intimate dinner with Chef Daniel Boulud at Boulud Sud Miami.

On Friday, Dec, 8, Haute Living is launching BAIN DE MER for the first time in the United States with a cocktail party on a luxe yacht.

JUSTIN Vineyards & Winery x Miami Art Week
------------------------------------------

Tuesday, Dec. 5 – Sunday, Dec. 10
---------------------------------

JUSTIN Vineyards & Winery is teaming up with Miami Art Week to host several events:

*   Dec. 5 to 10: Exclusive menu offerings and pairings available at the Design Miami café
*   Dec. 6: Featured partner at a private event hosted by PCS in the Collector’s Lounge and café space

*   Presenting wine sponsor for both the Pérez Art Museum PAMM Donor Dinner on Dec. 6 and PAMM Presents on Dec. 7
*   JUSTIN Lounge pop-ups across Miami including Loews Miami Beach and Intercontinental Miami
*   JUSTIN gallery partnerships at MOCA North Miami, Nina Johnson Gallery, Mindy Solomon Gallery, Locust Projects, WYN317 and more

Sagamore Hotel’s annual Art Brunch
----------------------------------

### Saturday, Dec. 9

Sagamore Hotel South Beach is hosting its 22nd annual poolside Art Brunch on Dec. 9.

“The epic event brings together the who’s who of the art community, welcoming hundreds of industry leaders spanning art, entertainment and social media for an alfresco afternoon of art, food, drink and surprise performances,” according to a press release.

Flex Presents “Flex Bash” Hosted by Passes 
-------------------------------------------

### Friday, Dec. 8

Finance app Flex and creator brand-friendly platform Passes are co-hosting an exclusive experience on a Venetian Island oasis with a surprise celebrity’s headlining performance.

The invitation-only event on Dec. 8 will include a curated list of the most influential entrepreneurs, investors and personalities in the world.

Past VIP attendees included Paris Hilton, Jared Leto, Jake Paul, Michael Bay and more.

 Art With Me festival
---------------------

### Friday, Dec. 8 – Sunday, Dec. 10

[![Image 5: Art Basel Miami. ](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2023/11/guests-view-art-display-art-73044952.jpg?w=1024)](https://pagesix.com/2023/12/03/society/art-basel-miami-2023-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 10 article images.")

The Art With Me festival is returning for Art Week. Getty Images

The Art With Me festival will return to Miami for its third Art Basel celebration of art, music, culture and wellness for the entire family.

Founded by nightlife aficionado David Graziano, the event will take place at Virginia Key Historic Park in Miami from Dec. 8 to Dec. 10.

Performers include Polo & Pan, Channel Tres, Lee Burridge, Jan Blomqvist, Jamime Elew & Friends, Nico Stojan, Parallelle, Underworld, LP Giobbi and Matt Caines, among others.

Superblue Art Week Party with JR / The Chronicles of Miami Unveiling
--------------------------------------------------------------------

### Tuesday, Dec. 5

Superblue and artist JR are unveiling the monumental new mural “The Chronicles of Miami” for an invite-only crowd that will enjoy music from Jose Parla.

Also debuting during Miami Art Week is one of JR’s most significant immersive works to date, “The Machine Behind the Art: Inside JR’s Printing Press,” created for Superblue. The installation invites visitors to walk through a portal-like door embedded into “The Chronicles of Miami” mural on the building’s façade.

 Art Miami + CONTEXT Art Miami Opening Night
--------------------------------------------

### Tuesday, Dec. 5

Art Miami, which year-over-year has been a central component of Miami Art Week and played a major role in establishing the city of Miami as a cultural hub, is returning to Miami Art Week, along with sister fair CONTEXT Art Miami.

The combination of Art Miami and CONTEXT Art Miami will feature over 215 galleries from 17 countries and will provide established and budding collectors the opportunity to acquire a vast array of iconic works from world-renowned artists, as well as groundbreaking works from emerging artists, at the prestigious Fairs.

An invitation-only VIP Preview on Tuesday, Dec. 5 and runs through Sunday, Dec.10, 2023.

American Express Art Week Lineup
--------------------------------

### Tuesday, Dec. 5 – Saturday, Dec. 9

American Express is hosting a number of events throughout Art Week, including the Resy Lounge cocktail party with chef Ayesha Nurdjaja on Dec. 5 at Untitled Art in South Beach and invite-only PLAY by Platinum House Party with LA-based DJ collective Donovan’s Yard.

AmEx is also hosting the SAVOR & SOUL brunch at The Miami Beach EDITION on Dec. 9.

Bleacher Report’s ‘The Residency’ at Art Basel
----------------------------------------------

### Friday, Dec. 8 – Saturday, Dec. 9

Bleacher Report is debuting “The Residency,” a year-long creative collective at the nexus of sports, art, fashion and culture, in partnership with the NBA.

The gallery experience will take place at The LAB Miami from Dec. 8 to Dec. 9 and kick off with a private VIP celebration.

The inaugural event will highlight the following artists and corresponding teams: Esther Wallace (Boston Celtics), Bryan “Blue the Great” Blue (Dallas Mavericks), D’ana “COVL” Nuñez (Miami Heat), Mark “MADSTEEZ” Paul Deren (Phoenix Suns) and Demitrius Omphroy (Toronto Raptors).

Giselle Miami Presents Dinner, Drinks and Live Art by Bisco Smith
-----------------------------------------------------------------

### Thursday, Dec. 7

Giselle Miami, the upscale rooftop restaurant above ultra-club E11even, will host a life art performance by graffiti artist Bisco Smith.

The dinner party on Dec. 7 will benefit Project Art Box, a nonprofit organization dedicated to bridging the art education gap in underprivileged schools.

Ocean Drive’s “Art of the Party” with Alessandra Ambrosio
---------------------------------------------------------

### Thursday, Dec. 7

[![Image 6: Alessandra Ambrosio ](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2023/11/2023-gq-men-year-bar-72484431.jpg?w=734)](https://pagesix.com/2023/12/03/society/art-basel-miami-2023-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 10 article images.")

Alessandra Ambrosio will host Ocean Drive’s annual “Art of the Party” event. FilmMagic

Alessandra Ambrosio will be hosting Ocean Drive’s annual “Art of the Party” event on Dec. 7.

The soirée on the La Côte lawn at the Fontainebleau Miami Beach will celebrate the release of this year’s December Art Issue featuring the Victoria’s Secret model on the cover.

The event will feature visual art by Romero Britto, sounds by Chromeo and a special guest performer.

Vintage Frames Company x Trevor “Trouble” Andrew Limited Edition Exhibition
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Thursday, Dec. 7 – Sunday, Dec. 10

The Vintage Frames Company Miami flagship store inside the Goodtime Hotel will host a limited edition exhibition featuring a collaboration with multi-hyphenate artist Trevor “Trouble” Andrew aka Gucci Ghost.

The exhibition highlights limited edition prints and sunglasses inspired by the artworks and will launch with an RSVP-only, 21+ party on Dec. 7.

Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Hollywood Celebrates Art Week
---------------------------------------------------------------

### Wednesday, Dec. 6 – Friday, Dec. 8 

[![Image 7: Sofía Vergara](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2023/12/2023-albies-clooney-foundation-justices-53101446.jpg?w=1024)](https://pagesix.com/2023/12/03/society/art-basel-miami-2023-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 10 article images.")

Sofía Vergara and other stars as set to hit the red carpet at the ceremonial first roll of Craps at the Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Hollywood. AFP via Getty Images

The week will kick off Wednesday, Dec. 6 with Tiësto performing at The Guitar Hotel Pool Party featuring a skydiving stunt by Red Bull Air Force.

The ceremonial first roll of craps, first spin of roulette and first sports bet will take place on Thursday, Dec. 7 at 4:30 p.m. with a red carpet to follow. A-List celebrities slated to attend include Sofía Vergara, Jon Bon Jovi, Tiësto, Heather Graham, DJ Khaled, Gloria and Emilio Estefan, Mike Tyson, Dwyane Wade, Bobbi Althoff, Sarah Hyland, and more. Diplo and Cedric Gervais will perform and partygoers will also enjoy passed canapes from Major Food Group’s Carbone.

Bruno Mars will perform at Hard Rock Live on Friday, Dec. 8 to a sold-out crowd.  The “24K Magic” star will later host DAER Dayclub After Dark with Tiësto.

Asta Resort pop-up launch party
-------------------------------

### Wednesday, Dec. 6

Asta Resort is celebrating its Miami Art Basel pop-up store by hosting a launch party at The Standard Spa in Miami on Dec. 6.

The party will then migrate to Monterrey Bar for dancing and cocktails.

Cincoro Tequila Celebrates Josh Vides
-------------------------------------

### Tuesday, Dec. 5

Michael Jordan’s Cincoro Tequila is partnering with visual artist Josh Vides to celebrate Art Week with an invitation-only soirée at the EDITION hotel on Dec. 5.

The tequila brand and Vides will launch their limited-edition bottles, which will be showcased at the event.

Soho Beach House Art Week lineup
--------------------------------

### Sunday, Dec. 3 – Sunday, Dec. 10

[![Image 8: Zack Bia. ](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2023/11/zack-bia-attends-red-white-18394479-edited.jpg)](https://pagesix.com/2023/12/03/society/art-basel-miami-2023-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 10 article images.")

Zack Bia will spin tunes at Soho Beach House during Art Week.

Soho Beach House has a jam-packed lineup of events in celebration of the annual art fair:

*   Sunday, Dec. 3: Soho Beach House will host 100% Pure Beach, the first-ever drag brunch and bingo with Dancing Phil and a DJ set from legendary Crystal Waters.
*   Monday, Dec. 4: British artist Harland Miller and Soho House global director of art Kate Bryan will discuss his latest works and the newly released Phaidon edition of his book at the Soho Beach House tent.
*   Wednesday, Dec. 6: Porsche will present an evening performance by the legendary Juvenile to celebrate an installation by Lyne Lucienon.
*   Wednesday, Dec. 6: Soho Beach House will host an Evian x Coperni beach party with special back-to-back sets from Odalys, Zack Bia and Chloé Caillet.
*   Thursday, Dec. 7: A party celebrating Parisian fashion label IRO with Amrit, Layla Benitez and Desiree as well as an Amazon Music x Soho House Latin night.
*   Friday, Dec. 8: A panel discussion with SSENSE and an Andrew x Slip n Slide Records party with Trick Daddy and Trina.
*   Saturday, Dec. 9: An afternoon with OG Magazine and Leon Bridges.
*   Sunday, Dec. 10: Soho Beach House will close out the week with a daytime party with No Vacancy featuring Hank Korsen, Benji B and Acyde.

The Pool at Strawberry Moon line-up
-----------------------------------

### Friday, Dec. 8 – Saturday, Dec. 9.

The Pool at Strawberry Moon, located at The Goodtime Hotel, will throw two must-see events during Art Week.

On Friday, Dec. 8,  Andrea Oliva, Arodes, Kimonos, Augusto Yepes, Purple, and Gustavo Ibarra will take to the stage to perform for a VIP crowd.

On Saturday, Dec. 9, Claptone will hit the DJ booth.

Sofia Design District Presents “Late-Night” with Chantel Jeffries
-----------------------------------------------------------------

### Thursday, Dec. 7

[![Image 9: Chantell Jeffries. ](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2023/12/2017-mtv-video-music-awards-24575053.jpg?w=669)](https://pagesix.com/2023/12/03/society/art-basel-miami-2023-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 10 article images.")

Chantel Jeffries will perform at Sofia Design District’s “Late-Night” party. Getty Images

Sofia Design District is throwing a ‘Late-Night at Sofia’ party during Miami Art Week where Chantel Jeffries will perform on Dec. 7.

Guests will be able to indulge in the finest culinary offerings from Sofia’s late-night menu, plus an enticing array of specially curated bottle service packages, and a distinctive art collection presented by Taglialatella Galleries.

Sexy Fish Art Party
-------------------

### Mon. Dec. 4 – Sunday, Dec. 10

Drake-approved hotspot Sexy Fish is honoring Art Week by displaying pieces by artist Damien Hirst.

Diners will also enjoy tunes spun by famous German DJ and producer Claptone.

E11EVEN Miami Presents “The Art of Nightlife” 
----------------------------------------------

### Wednesday, Dec. 6 – Sunday, Dec. 10

In honor of Miami Art Week this year, E11EVEN Miami will present “The Art of Nightlife,” highlighting the occasion with a thrilling lineup of performances and the debut of an exclusive apparel collaboration with renowned designer John Geiger.

Performers set to take the stage throughout the week include Cedric Gervais, Diplo, Snoop Dogg, Lil Wayne and DeadMau5.

E11EVEN Vodka is also hosting a Bottle Design Contest. All aspiring artists, creative and graphic designers, or overall fans of the E11EVEN Brand are welcome to take part in the chance to see their art skills featured on a Miami-inspired Limited Edition E11EVEN Vodka Bottle, which will be presented to the public on 305 day, March 5, 2024. The winner will also be awarded a Grand Prize Package including $1,100 in prize money, and a table at the nightclub.

Nylon lineup
------------

### Friday, Dec. 8 – Saturday, Dec. 9

[![Image 10: Cara at Nylon House in 2022. ](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2023/11/2022-strawberry-moon-goodtime-hotel-3505045.jpg?w=683)](https://pagesix.com/2023/12/03/society/art-basel-miami-2023-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 10 article images.")

Past attendees of Nylon House include Ciara and Kim Kardashian. Getty Images for Nylon

This year, Nylon will be hosting two big events.

The magazine’s massive annual Nylon House event, presented by e.l.f. Cosmetics, will take place beachfront on Dec. 8 and feature headliners Rampa of Keinemusik.

The next night, Nylon Nights will take over a yet-to-be-announced location for a more private gathering offering DJ sets by Guy Gerber and Sushi by Bou as well as Patrón cocktails.

Red Rooster Overtown Celebrates Hip-Hop 50th Anniversary
--------------------------------------------------------

### Sunday, Dec. 10

Red Rooster Overtown, the acclaimed Overtown restaurant presented by Marcus Samuelsson, Derek Fleming and Michael Simkins, will be hosting a Hip-Hop 50th Anniversary celebration and panel discussion sponsored by Uncle Nearest on Sunday, Dec.10.

Panelists will include Hip-Hop legends Jarobi White (A Tribe Called Quest) K Foxx  (99Jamz) DJ EFN (Drink Champs) DJ Nasty305 (99 Jamz), and a surprise special guest. The panel will be moderated by DJ TilleryJames (The DJ Collective) and C. Isaiah Small II (Miami Herald).

The event will be held at The Pool Hall atop Red Rooster and attendees can expect complimentary light bites and admission is free.

Keith Haring’s First Art Basel Show
-----------------------------------

### Monday, Dec. 4 – Thursday, January. 11

In a first-ever Miami Beach exhibit, NYC graffiti artist Keith Haring’s artwork went up on display exclusively at The National Hotel Miami Beach, debuted by the Keith Haring Foundation.

The exhibit was kicked off by a panel discussion with the Keith Haring Foundation Executive Director Gil Vasquez and artist Alexandre Diop, a young Franco-Senegalese artist, on Dec. 4.

Fuel Venture Capital’s Yacht Party
----------------------------------

### Thursday, Dec. 7

Fuel Venture Capital is hosting its annual invite-only yacht party aboard the 120-foot luxury Sealyon yacht featuring artist Noel Dobarganes Perez.

The mega yacht has previously been chartered by Cardi B, Sofía Vergera and more.

25.content:
[![Image 1](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2024/10/snoop-dogg-performs-onstage-wayne-94630031.jpg?w=693)](https://pagesix.com/society/art-basel-miami-beach-2024-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 14 article images.")

Art Basel Miami Beach 2024 is sure to promise a star-studded lineup. Getty Images for 4WRD

Each December, celebrities, athletes, billionaires and influencers descend on Miami to attend Art Basel Miami Beach.

While much of the glitterati will be in town to purchase some new art pieces, others will simply enjoy the lavish celebrations surrounding Art Week.

Past A-listers making the rounds at Art Basel have included Snoop Dogg, Kim Kardashian, [Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Brady.](https://pagesix.com/2023/12/09/entertainment/leonardo-dicaprio-and-tom-brady-party-together-at-star-studded-art-basel-miami-bash/)

Keep reading to find out which stars are heading to Florida this year.

Celsius x Padel Reserve
-----------------------

### Friday, Dec. 6

The Celsius Classic is back for the second year at Reserve Padel in Miami on Friday, Dec. 6.

A-listers and influencers are expected to attend and participate in the charity-driven padel tournament.

Guests can enjoy curated bites, Celsius beverages, a live DJ set and gifted limited-edition merch.

The Tribeca Festival at Art Basel Miami Beach
---------------------------------------------

### Friday, Dec. 4 – Saturday, Dec. 7

[![Image 2: Camila Cabello at a conference. ](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2024/10/2024-penn-district-galleria-skylight-94629995.jpg?w=1024)](https://pagesix.com/society/art-basel-miami-beach-2024-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 14 article images.")

Camila Cabello, seen here in October 2024, will headline The Tribeca Festival at Art Basel Miami Beach this year. Getty Images for The Galleria by Skylight in THE PENN DISTRICT

Tribeca Festival at Art Basel Miami Beach, in association with Art Basel and presented by The Ordinary and ESPN, will take place at the Miami Beach Bandshell from Dec. 4 to Dec. 7.

Programming will include a headlining conversation with Camila Cabello, performances by artists Magdalena Bay, Makaya McCraven, Neggy Gemmy and Luedji Luna, and DJ sets by Brainville and Natasha Diggs and L3NI.

There will also be a retrospective screening of Mike Nichols’ 1996 film “The Birdcage,” followed by a drag show from the queens of Palace South Beach.

Judith Lieber x Sexy Fish
-------------------------

### Wednesday, Dec. 4

Sexy Fish is partnering with Judith Leiber Couture to celebrate the brand’s latest collaboration with artist Ashley Longshore and the debut of the alluring Bust Bag collection with a luncheon on Dec. 4.

The event will preview the brand’s Holiday ’24 collection and guests will be treated to special glittery gifts.

Judith Leiber Couture’s EVP and Chief Creative Officer Jana Matheson will be there to host the stylish event.

The Cultivist x Captial One x Hassan Hajjaj
-------------------------------------------

### Tuesday, Dec. 3

[![Image 3](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2024/10/anderson-paak-seen-outside-gq-94630020.jpg?w=819)](https://pagesix.com/society/art-basel-miami-beach-2024-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 14 article images.")

Anderson .Paak, seen here in November 2024, will perform at The Cultivist x Capital One event. GC Images

The Cultivist, Capital One and Hassan Hajjaj are partnering to bring Morocco’s heritage and vibrancy to life with a fully immersive art installation and lineup of public programming and VIP events with an invite-only preview on Dec. 3.

The Hassan Hajjaj pop-up titled DAR MIAMI will then be open to the public.

Capital One cardholders and VIPs will have access to two unique dining experiences curated by Michelin star Chef Rose Previte and live music performances by Simo Lagnawi, Anderson. Paak, Kaytranada and more.

Attendees will also have access to limited edition merch designed by Hajjaj including wearable items and homewares inspired by Moroccan Heritage.

Museum of Art and Design at Miami Dade College
----------------------------------------------

### Monday, Dec. 2 – Saturday, March 15, 2025

Museum of Art and Design at Miami Dade College, in partnership with the Women Artists Archive Miami, will present Kabuya Pamela Bowens-Saffo: From the Heights., marking the artist’s first-ever solo show.

“Her impact on South Florida’s cultural landscape is celebrated in this first-of-its-kind exhibition featuring archival materials presented alongside artwork from the early 80s to the present that is deeply tied to the community,” a press release states. “Specializing in printmaking and mixed media constructions, her art delves into social and political human relations, emphasizing the African American experience.”

The event is open to the public.

LIV Miami x Art Week
--------------------

### Thursday, Dec. 5 – Sunday, Dec. 8

[![Image 4: DJ Khalen in October 2024. ](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2024/10/003-statues-forever-party-fwrd-94630003.jpg?w=715)](https://pagesix.com/society/art-basel-miami-beach-2024-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 14 article images.")

DJ Khaled, seen here in Miami in October 2024, will hit the stage at Liv Miami. Getty Images for FWRD

LIV Miami is celebrating Art Week with a stellar line-up of performances throughout the week.

Artists expected to take the stage at David Grutman’s beloved nightclub include Diplo, DJ Khaled, John Summit and Lil Wayne.

American Express x Art Week
---------------------------

### Wednesday, Dec. 4 – Sunday, Dec. 8

The Resy Lounge is returning to the Untitled Art Fair, presented by Delta Air Lines and American Express.

Guests can use the space to sit back, relax, and enjoy complimentary food and beverages by Jon & Vinny’s.

Eligible Delta Air Lines American Express card members will gain access to exclusive offerings including specialty dishes, dedicated bars serving Helen’s Wines and Helen’s exclusive cocktails, outdoor cabanas, curated gift bags and a meet and greet with renowned artist Justin Lim.

### Thursday, Dec. 5

Night Shift at Jon & Vinny’s, hosted by American Express and Delta, is a one-night event at the Rubell Museum.

The after-hours party will include intimate performances from surprise musical guests, cocktails and late night Jon & Vinny’s pizza to-go, in limited edition American Express x Delta pizza boxes.

### Friday, Dec. 6

Delta Air Lines and American Express are offering complimentary Jon & Vinny’s breakfast pizzas at the Rubell Museum

### Saturday, Dec. 7

WANDERLUST presented by Marriott Bonvoy American Express will host its 8th Annual Miami Art Basel party at the W South Beach on Dec. 7.

This exclusive Card Member party will bring the popular Resy restaurant, Superbueno, to Miami Beach for a taste of iconic Mexican dishes, immersive art sculptures from renowned visual artist Jimena Montemayor, and sounds from South Africa with amapiano performing DJ Uncle Waffles.

Ostrow Brasserie x Art Basel
----------------------------

### Monday, Dec. 2

[![Image 5](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2024/10/amare-stoudemire-attends-calvin-klein-34575842.jpg?w=683)](https://pagesix.com/society/art-basel-miami-beach-2024-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 14 article images.")

Amar’e Stoudemire, seen here in June 2013, will host a wine pairing dinner party at Ostrow Brasserie. Getty Images

Ostrow Brasserie, Miami’s first Kosher-French restaurant helmed by world-renowned French chef Olivia Ostrow, will celebrate Art Basel with an extraordinary four-course wine pairing dinner hosted by Amar’e Stoudemire.

The founder of Stoudemire Wines will be curating the wine pairings from Israel and guests will dine on dishes inspired by Israeli artists Gil Goren, Nir Segal and Brian Poli-Dixon.

Venezuelan artist, LAMACA, will give a live performance at the event.

Christopher King Grand Opening
------------------------------

### Wednesday, Dec. 4.

Christopher King, a true embodiment of ultra-luxury and heritage-rich craftsmanship, will celebrate its official debut.

The eponymous brand offers a curated collection of premium leather goods, distinguished accessories, artisanal home pieces, and furniture.

King will host an invite-only celebration, with Krug Champagne, at the brand’s new flagship store in Coral Gables.

Fuel Venture Capital x Tony Kelly
---------------------------------

### Friday, Dec. 6

Fuel Venture Capital will host a special book signing with Tony Kelly aboard the Sealyon yacht.

The soirée is by invitation only.

The Wellness Oasis presented by Chase
-------------------------------------

### Thursday, Dec. 5 to Friday, Dec. 6

[![Image 6: Joe Jonas in June 2024. ](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2024/10/joe-jonas-attends-sunset-cocktails-94629993.jpg?w=683)](https://pagesix.com/society/art-basel-miami-beach-2024-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 14 article images.")

Joe Jonas, seen here in June 2024, will speak at The Wellness Oasis at 1 Hotel. Getty Images for One&Only

The Wellness Oasis™ presented by Chase is a transformative event platform and community dedicated to helping people with their mental, physical, and spiritual well-being.

Experts and stars including Deepak Chopra, Goldie Hawn, Melissa Tepperberg, and Joe Jonas will lead workshops and conversations about mindfulness, togetherness and more.

The event will take place at 1 Hotel South Beach and is being produced by 4B Advisory.

Will.i.am x Mercedes-Benz
-------------------------

### Wednesday, Dec. 4

[![Image 7: Will.i.am in November 2024. ](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2024/10/2024-lacma-art-film-gala-94630004.jpg?w=683)](https://pagesix.com/society/art-basel-miami-beach-2024-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 14 article images.")

Will.i.am, seen here in November 2024, is collaborating with Mercedes-Benz for a party at Nikki Beach. Getty Images for LACMA

Will.i.am is teaming up with Mercedes-Benz to celebrate the brand’s new entertainment system, MBUX Sound Drive.

The event will take place at Nikki Beach.

The Ritz-Carlton, South Beach x Art Basel
-----------------------------------------

### Tuesday, Dec. 3

The Ritz-Carlton, South Beach, an official sponsor of Art Basel Miami 2024, is celebrating Women in the Spotlight with the unveiling of “As her hands move, her heart beats in the rhythm of monsoons,” a site- specific sculpture by celebrated artist Amanda Phingbodhipakkiya, this year’s recipient  
of the Bank of America Artadia Award.

Set to be unveiled in the hotel’s lobby on Tuesday, Dec. 3rd, this commissioned installation is part of a collaboration with Artadia. Artadia will also unveil the inaugural SEEN Award and a limited edition print by 2016 NADA Artadia Awardee Summer Wheat at The Ritz-Carlton, South Beach during Art Week.

In addition to Phingbodhipakkiya’s installation, the design-forward property will also display Wheat’s limited edition print in conjunction with global publisher Phaidon.

Hallucinarium x Art Week
------------------------

### Sunday, Dec. 8

Elrow’s brand-new immersive show, Hallucinarium, was designed in partnership with iconic psychedelic artists Alex & Allyson Grey and will be held at Factory Town.

The boundary-pushing show “draws inspiration from the Greys’ trademark sacred geometry and visionary iconography, creating an immersive spectacle of mind-bending stage sets, larger-than-life costumes, and interactive art installations that bring to life an unparalleled multi-sensory experience,” according to a press release.

CONTEXT Art Miami x Derek Jeter
-------------------------------

### Tuesday, Dec. 3 – Sunday, Dec. 8

[![Image 8: Derek Jeter in August 2023. ](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2024/10/derek-jeter-attends-hip-hop-94629988.jpg?w=683)](https://pagesix.com/society/art-basel-miami-beach-2024-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 14 article images.")

Derek Jeter, seen here in August 2023, has partnered with Russell Young for a cause. WireImage

Art Miami is partnering with Major League Baseball to debut a captivating artwork by acclaimed artist Russell Young, featuring New York Yankees legend Derek Jeter.

A portion of the proceeds will support Derek’s Turn 2 Foundation and the Perry J. Cohen Foundation.

Grey Goose x Art Week
---------------------

### Thursday, Dec. 5

[![Image 9: Diplo in November 2024. ](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2024/10/diplo-performs-onstage-day-1-94630016.jpg?w=1024)](https://pagesix.com/society/art-basel-miami-beach-2024-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 14 article images.")

Diplo, seen here in November 2024, will spin tunes at the MSCHF x Grey Goose event. Getty Images

Grey Goose vodka will unveil its first-ever A.I.R. Chateau — a one-night-only artists in residence (A.I.R.) experience created in partnership with art collective MSCHF at a private villa in Miami Beach.

The event will showcase boundary-defying works at the peak of their craft, including new and beloved works from MSCHF and a DJ set by Diplo.

D’USSÉ x Art Week
-----------------

### Friday, Dec. 6

[![Image 10: Hit-Boy with D'USSÉ Cognac. ](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2024/12/hit-boy.jpg?w=683)](https://pagesix.com/society/art-basel-miami-beach-2024-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 14 article images.")

Music producer Hit-Boy is one of the backers of D’USSÉ Cognac. D’USSÉ Cognac

D’USSÉ Cognac is throwing an invite-only party.

Grammy-winning producer Hit-Boy will host the evening of curated beats and cocktails and Chase B and Spinser Tracy will spin tunes.

The soirée will celebrate D’USSÉ and Hit-Boy’s new limited-edition holiday gift box and augmented reality experience called “The Set.”

Nikki Beach x Art Week
----------------------

### Thursday, Dec. 5

Nikki Beach Miami is hosting “Basel on The Beach” with performances by DJs Eran Hersh, EC Twins, Sam Haze and more.

Habibi x Art Week
-----------------

### Friday, Dec. 6

Habibi, Miami’s newest hotspot, is celebrating Art Week with a live art showcase by artist Mr. Drip.

----------------------------

### Monday, Dec. 2 – Tuesday, Dec. 3

Maison Margiela x Kozo

Maison Margiela is celebrating tattoo artist Kozo with an exclusive celebration at the brand’s Miami Design District store.

The Brooklyn-based tattoo artist — known for his micro-realistic colored tattoos that juxtapose classical art, such as Old Masters, with modern pop culture references — will co-host the event showcasing a selection of Margiela Signature White Icons customized with his black-and-white-tattoo iconography.

--------------------------------

[![Image 11: Chance The Rapper in October 2024. ](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2024/10/chance-rapper-attends-project-healthy-91387094.jpg?w=1024)](https://pagesix.com/society/art-basel-miami-beach-2024-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 14 article images.")

Ocean Drive’s annual “Art of the Party” event will be hosted by Chance The Rapper.

Taking place on the grandiose Ocean & La Côte Lawn at Fontainebleau Miami Beach,’ the evening will celebrate the release of the glossy’s December Art Issue featuring the rapper on the cover.

DJ Crespo will give an opening performance before Chance takes to the stage. Gianluca Vacchi will close out the evening.

Boich Family Cellar x Ross Caliendo
-----------------------------------

### Friday, Dec. 6

Boich Family Cellar is collaborating with acclaimed artist Ross Caliendo to create an exclusive label artwork for the 2022 Perennius Cabernet Sauvignon Art Edition.

John Boich and Ross Caliendo will host a private unveiling on Dec. 6, 2024, from 3pm to 6pm at Ross + Kramer Gallery, celebrating the fusion of fine art and exceptional winemaking.

Queen Omakase x Atlas
---------------------

### Thursday, Dec. 5 – Saturday, Dec. 7

Queen Omakase will present an exclusive, multi-sensory dining experience titled the “4 Hands Omakase Collaboration” on Dec. 5, 6, and 7.

Marion Miami x Art Week
-----------------------

Denver’s Yacht Club x Sweet Liberty Drinks and Supply Co.
---------------------------------------------------------

### Thursday, Dec. 5

Denver’s Yacht Club is teaming up with Miami Beach’s beloved hotspot Sweet Liberty for a one-night pop-up event.

E11even x Art Week
------------------

### Wednesday, Dec. 4 – Sunday, Dec. 8

E11even Miami presents “The Art of Nightlife” and the Inaugural Golf Classic for this year’s Art Week.

Artists scheduled to perform include 50 Cent, Steve Aoki and Lil Wayne.

**The Grand Opening of Christopher King’s THE PALAZZO**

### Wednesday, Dec. 4

Guests are invited to step into a world of timeless elegance and extraordinary vision for the unveiling of Christopher King: Made In Italy.

Attendees will indulge in an evening inspired by the opulence of the roaring twenties, with live music featuring endless champagne by Krug, gourmet caviar and passed hors d’oeuvres, and signature martinis and manhattans.

Wynwood Walls x Art Week
------------------------

### Monday, Dec. 2

[![Image 13: Fatboy Slim in October 2024. ](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2024/10/2024-festival-halle-de-la-91049362.jpg?w=1024)](https://pagesix.com/society/art-basel-miami-beach-2024-biggest-parties-and-events/# "Open a slideshow of all 14 article images.")

Fatboy Slim, seen here in October 2024, will perform at the 15th anniversary party for Wynwood Walls. AFP via Getty Images

Wynwood Walls is celebrating Miami Art Week with an opening night party to celebrate the 15th Anniversary of Wynwood Walls.

Mandarin Oriental Miami
-----------------------

### Wednesday, Dec. 4 – Sunday, Dec. 8

### Thursday, Dec. 5

### Friday, Dec. 6

Friday, Dec. 6

### Tuesday, Dec. 3

The event will feature a panel on female entrepreneurship led by artist Jenny Chandler, followed by a vibrant specialty cocktail experience, as well as a caviar station, wine and more.

-------------------------------------

### Saturday, Dec. 7

### Tuesday, Dec. 2

Complimentary styling and touchups will be offered and guests will enjoy customized gifts, cocktails, bites, and a chance to explore and test Ulta’s latest products.

### Friday, Dec. 6 – Sunday, Dec. 8

**[Justin Timberlake](https://www.eonline.com/news/justin_timberlake)** and **[Jessica Biel](https://www.eonline.com/news/jessica_biel)** helped bring SexyBack to Sin City.

[The couple](https://www.eonline.com/news/1387341/proof-justin-timberlake-and-jessica-biel-are-in-seventh-heaven-on-italian-getaway) stepped out for a star-studded date night as they celebrated the grand opening of the $3.7 billion Fontainebleau Las Vegas resort and casino Dec. 13.

Jessica, 41, wore a white draped gown with a thigh-high slit and black studded stiletto sandals while Justin, 42, sported a black tux and later appeared in a white one while performing onstage during the event.

The couple shared a photo from their date night on their [Instagrams](https://www.instagram.com/p/C02EO2HJC2D/). Jessica captioned her post, "On our suit and tie s--t."

The _Sinner_ actress followed it up with a selfie of herself wearing her husband of 11 years' bow tie, writing, "Morning after bow tie snatcher."

At the launch—where Justin performed several of his songs—the pair was joined at the launch by fellow celebs such as **[Kim Kardashian](https://www.eonline.com/news/kim_kardashian)**, **[Kendall Jenner](https://www.eonline.com/news/kendall_jenner)**, **[Cher](https://www.eonline.com/news/cher)**, **[Eva Longoria](https://www.eonline.com/news/eva_longoria)**, **[Sylvester Stallone](https://www.eonline.com/news/sylvester_stallone)**, **[Lenny Kravitz](https://www.eonline.com/news/lenny_kravitz), [Ian Somerhalder](https://www.eonline.com/news/ian_somerhalder)** and **[Nikki Reed](https://www.eonline.com/news/nikki_reed)**, _Breaking Bad_'s **[Bryan Cranston](https://www.eonline.com/news/bryan_cranston)** and **[Aaron Paul](https://www.eonline.com/news/aaron_paul)** and **[Tom Brady](https://www.eonline.com/news/tom_brady)**.

Afterwards, Justin, Jessica and several of the other stars were spotted gambling together at the casino.

ACES / BACKGRID

As Justin wrote of the evening on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/C0177k9uzRe/?hl=en), alongside photos of him on and offstage, "1 night in Vegas."

Denise Truscello/Getty Images for Fontainebleau Las Vegas

After the performance, Justin and Jessica—who are parents to sons **Silas**, 8, and **Phineas**, 3—headed to Fontainebleau's LIV nightclub.

The Vegas outing was just the latest star-studded date night for the longtime couple, as [Jessica accompanied](https://www.eonline.com/news/1389980/justin-timberlakes-red-carpet-reunion-with-nsync-doubled-as-a-rare-date-night-with-jessica-biel) the [\*NSYNC](https://www.eonline.com/news/n_sync) alum to the _Trolls Band Together_ premiere in November.

And for the duo, spending time together is how they keep their bond strong.

"Justin always says, 'We cannot stop dating, we have to keep dating,'" Jessica explained on [_Today with Hoda and Jenna_](https://www.eonline.com/news/1381430/jessica-biel-proves-shes-boyfriend-justin-timberlakes-biggest-fan) last year. "And he's right, you have to go on date nights. You have to take that time for yourself."

SplashNews.com

Keep reading for a look back at Justin and Jessica's cutest family moments over the years...

Instagram / Jessica Biel

Loving Hugs


-------------

"Happy Father’s Day to my spectacular husband who is one incredible dad," [**Jessical Biel**](https://www.eonline.com/news/jessica_biel) wrote in an [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DK70OJxp6jx/?img_index=1) tribute to [**Justin Timberlake**](https://www.eonline.com/news/justin_timberlake) in June 2025. "And to all the other dads out there doing their thing. Leading with humility and vulnerability. Showin up with understanding and compassion, and always using humor to get through the hard stuff. Major respect and love to all y’all."

After facing multiple lawsuits in recent months alleging sexual assault and other crimes, [Sean Combs](https://www.rollingstone.com/t/sean-combs/) was indicted Sept. 17 on charges of sex trafficking by force, racketeering conspiracy, fraud or coercion and transporting for prostitution. Combs’ attorney, Marc Agnifilo, called it an “unjust prosecution,” and said his client is “an innocent man with nothing to hide.”

In November, Casandra “Cassie” Ventura kicked off what became a tsunami of accusations against Combs with a lawsuit against Combs in New York federal court that included graphic claims of sexual assault, physical abuse, and an allegation that Combs, her ex-boyfriend, would force her to have sex with male sex workers while he watched.

The recent charges are not the first controversies that the music mogul and entrepreneur has faced over the years. Combs has attempted to rebrand himself as “Brother Love,” but he has a prolonged history of allegations of violence, dating back to the Nineties. He’s never been convicted of a serious crime, but has repeatedly been accused of having violent encounters with everyone from his exes Ventura and Gina Huynh (who alleged physical abuse in 2019) to executive Steve Stoute and rappers like J. Cole and Drake.

CCNY Tragedy, 1991
------------------

Combs co-promoted a celebrity basketball game and concert at City College of New York where nine people died and 29 people were injured. The gym had a capacity of 2,730 people but as many as 5,000 people showed up to the event, which didn’t have enough security to control the throng. After organizers closed the doors and stopped letting attendees in, people outside broke the gymnasium’s doors and rushed the lobby, causing a stampede. Then-New York City Mayor David Dinkins’ administration published a 67-page report called “A Failure Of Responsibility” that cited Combs for hiring inadequate, inexperienced security. Combs settled a slew of lawsuits from family members of attendees who died at the gymnasium, finalizing the last suit in 2000.

Jake Robles Shooting, 1995
--------------------------

Combs and Death Row Records co-founder Marion “Suge” Knight were once friends, but the animosity that fueled the violent rivalry between Death Row and Bad Boy started once Knight’s friend (and security guard) Jake Robles was killed outside an Atlanta nightclub after an argument with the Bad Boy camp. The men were celebrating musician Jermaine Dupri’s birthday at Platinum City Club when, as then-Fulton County Sheriff Deputy Chris Howard told police, an argument began between members of the Bad Boy and Death Row Records entourage. Howard said that he escorted Combs and his guests outside to leave the club, and thought the coast was clear to allow Knight and his entourage to leave. But, as Howard told the _Los Angeles Times_, “\[Knight’s\] partner was just about ready to get into the limo when all of a sudden Puffy’s guys came from around the corner . . . and one of them had a gun.” Howard said he chased the man, who handed the gun to another person, who shot Robles “two or three times.” According to the Times, the person then jumped into a “car carrying Combs’ associates.” Robles died weeks later at an Atlanta hospital. Combs has denied involvement in the shooting, which Knight reportedly held him responsible for.
