32.content:
Last week, Casandra “Cassie” Ventura [filed a federal lawsuit](https://au.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/sean-combs-cassie-abuse-allegations-lawsuit-52514/) against Sean “Diddy” Combs in New York federal court. Her lawsuit includes graphic claims of sexual assault, physical abuse, and an allegation that Combs, her ex-boyfriend, would force her to have sex with male sex workers while he watched. Ventura’s claims are among the worst, but not the first controversy that the music mogul and entrepreneur has been alleged to be involved in.

Combs has attempted to rebrand himself as “Brother Love” in recent years, even changing his middle name to Love, but he has a prolonged history of violence, dating back to the Nineties. He’s never been convicted of a serious crime but has repeatedly been accused of having violent encounters with everyone from his exes Ventura and Gina Huynh (who alleged physical abuse in 2019) to executive Steve Stoute and rappers like J. Cole and Drake.

Combs’ attorney Ben Brafman told the _New York Times_ that “Mr. Combs vehemently denies these offensive and outrageous allegations. For the past six months, Mr. Combs has been subjected to Ms. Ventura’s persistent demand of $30 million, under the threat of writing a damaging book about their relationship, which was unequivocally rejected as blatant blackmail. Despite withdrawing her initial threat, Ms. Ventura has now resorted to filing a lawsuit riddled with baseless and outrageous lies, aiming to tarnish Mr. Combs’s reputation and seeking a payday.” The two reached an “amicable” settlement for an undisclosed amount on Nov. 17.

Here is a timeline of Combs’ controversies over the years:

### CCNY Tragedy, 1991

Combs co-promoted a celebrity basketball game and concert at City College of New York where nine people died and 29 people were injured. The gym had a capacity of 2,730 people but as many as 5,000 people showed up to the event, which didn’t have enough security to control the throng. After organizers closed the doors and stopped letting attendees in, people outside broke the gymnasium’s doors and rushed the lobby, causing a stampede. Then-New York City Mayor David Dinkins’ administration published a 67-page report called “A Failure Of Responsibility” that cited Combs for hiring inadequate, inexperienced security. Combs settled a slew of lawsuits from family members of attendees who died at the gymnasium, finalizing the last suit in 2000.

### Jake Robles Shooting, 1995

Combs and Death Row Records co-founder Marion “Suge” Knight were once friends, but the animosity that fueled the violent rivalry between Death Row and Bad Boy started once Knight’s friend (and security guard) Jake Robles was killed outside an Atlanta nightclub after an argument with the Bad Boy camp. The men were celebrating musician Jermaine Dupri’s birthday at Platinum City Club when, as then-Fulton County Sheriff Deputy Chris Howard told police, an argument began between members of the Bad Boy and Death Row Records entourage. Howard said that he escorted Combs and his guests outside to leave the club, and thought the coast was clear to allow Knight and his entourage to leave. But, as Howard told the _Los Angeles Times_, “\[Knight’s\] partner was just about ready to get into the limo when all of a sudden Puffy’s guys came from around the corner . . . and one of them had a gun.” Howard said he chased the man, who handed the gun to another person, who shot Robles “two or three times.” According to the Times, the person then jumped into a “car carrying Combs’ associates.” Robles died weeks later at an Atlanta hospital. Combs has denied involvement in the shooting, which Knight reportedly held him responsible for.

### Attacking Steve Stoute, 1998

In 1998, Combs and two other men attacked Steve Stoute after the music executive, then Nas’ manager, erroneously sent MTV a version of Combs and Nas’ “Hate Me Now” music video which contained scenes depicting Combs as Jesus Christ being crucified. Combs wanted the crucifixion scene deleted from the video, and was enraged that it played on-air. Stoute says that Combs and two men barged into his New York City office and attacked him with a champagne bottle. He was charged with second-degree assault and criminal mischief. Stoute claims that his arm and jaw was broken in the attack, but Combs denied any bones were broken to MTV, also telling the network, “I basically went to his office, and what happened in his office, I really can’t speak about but I can say this: the way I handled myself in his office was completely wrong and I’ve since apologized to Steve about that and I felt like, you know, I just disappointed myself.” Combs was sentenced to a one-day anger management class.

Love Music?
-----------

Get your daily dose of everything happening in Australian/New Zealand music and globally.

![Image 1](https://images-r2-2.thebrag.com/common/spinner.gif)

### Club New York Shooting, 1999

In late December 1999, Combs and his Bad Boy signee Jamal “Shyne” Barrow were partying at Club New York when Diddy knocked a drink out of Matthew “Scar” Allen’s hands. Allen got into an argument with Combs and someone threw money in Combs’ face. Allen also threatened to kill Shyne. Prosecutors allege that amid the fray, all three men drew guns, and Shyne shot three times in the crowded club. Three people were shot. Combs, who was arrested with two nine-millimeter guns in his car, was charged with four weapons charges and for bribing his driver to claim that the guns were his own. A witness at the trial said she saw both Shyne and Combs shoot their weapons, but Combs was acquitted on all charges, while Shyne was found guilty of five of his eight charges and was sentenced to 10 years in prison.

### Scuffle with J. Cole, 2013

In 2013, Combs was allegedly involved in an altercation with J. Cole at a 2013 MTV VMAs afterparty. Multiple sources alleged to Complex that a “visibly intoxicated” Combs accosted Kendrick Lamar about his fiery verse on Big Sean’s “Control,” where he bragged he was “King of New York.” Combs allegedly tried to pour a drink on Kendrick before Cole intervened and they got into a fight. The _New York Post_, however, [reported](https://pagesix.com/2013/08/27/sean-diddy-combs-scuffles-with-rapper-j-cole-during-star-studded-vmas-party/) that the scuffle occurred after “J. Cole was saying inappropriate things to Sean Combs and his girlfriend, Cassie.” A witness told them that “Some pushing and shoving happened. No punches were thrown, but it was a visible disturbance.” Both men immediately denied a fight took place, though Cole later rapped, “My last scrap was with Puff Daddy, who would’ve thought it?” on 2021’s “Let Go My Hand.”

### Allegedly Punches Drake, 2014

In December 2014, Combs allegedly punched Drake over the rights to the beat that became Drake’s “0 to 100.” The [Miami New-Times reported](https://www.miaminewtimes.com/music/diddy-punches-drake-at-liv-miami-6445458) that the two got into an argument outside of LIV nightclub during DJ Khaled’s event for Basel Weekend. Words were allegedly exchanged, and reportedly, “then blows,” with Combs telling Drake, “You will not disrespect me.” Combs has denied punching Drake, telling the radio show _The Breakfast Club_ “I didn’t do nothing to Drake, Drake is my friend.”

### Fights UCLA Coach, 2015

In June of 2015, Combs got into a scuffle with then-UCLA assistant football coach Sal Alosi. [TMZ reported](http://www.tmz.com/2015/06/22/diddy-arrested-fight-ucla-football-coach-justin/) that Combs was present during a UCLA practice where Alosi chided his son (and then-UCLA player) Justin Combs, telling him, “I don’t care if your dad’s here. This is UCLA. I’m going to treat you just like I treat everyone else.” After the practice, Combs and his son reportedly went to Alosi’s office, where an argument ensued and Combs “grabbed” Alosi. According to one account, Combs was forcibly removed from Alosi’s office and then swung a kettlebell at an intern. A rep for Combs Enterprises noted, “The various accounts of the event and charges that are being reported are wholly inaccurate. What we can say now is that any actions taken by Mr. Combs were solely defensive in nature to protect himself and his son.” The LA district attorney decided not to file assault charges against Combs.

### Gina Huynh Alleges Abuse

In 2019 Combs’ ex Gina Huynh [told blogger Tasha K](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=smgWDZF-QjA) that Combs physically abused her throughout their five-year relationship. She claimed he once stomped her on the stomach, causing her to lose her breath, and also punched her in the back of the head. She told Tasha K that, “He was mentally, emotionally and physically abusing me. He would always compare me to Cassie and tell me that I’m the bad one, she’s a good one.” She also said that “everyone” in Combs’ circle “allowed” the abuse to occur.

### Cassie Files Civil Suit Against Combs

On Nov. 16th, Combs’ ex Casandra “Cassie” Ventura filed a federal lawsuit against Combs in New York alleging years of assault. Her lawsuit contains graphic allegations of Combs raping her in 2018, physically abusing her, intimidating her, and making her have sex with male escorts while he watched. The lawsuit also alleges that Combs blew up Cudi’s car to deter him from seeing Cassie romantically — through a rep, Cudi said the accusations are true. Combs has denied the allegations and alleged that Cassie tried to blackmail him for $30 million before filing the lawsuit. The two settled for an undisclosed amount on Nov. 17, with his attorney Ben Brafman stating that “Mr. Combs‘ decision to settle the lawsuit does not in any way undermine his flat-out denial of the claims.”

_From [Rolling Stone US](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-features/sean-diddy-combs-controversies-timeline-1234889043/)_

30.content:
Machine Gun Kelly Introduces “New Addition” to His Home After Welcoming Baby With Megan Fox

[**Machine Gun Kelly**](https://www.eonline.com/news/machine_gun_kelly) is locked in.

Musically speaking, that is. The rapper made a surprise appearance along with his pal **Travis Barker** during **Three 6 Mafia**'s April 11 set at Coachella, his first performance since [welcoming a baby girl with ex-fiancée **Megan Fox** on March 27](https://www.eonline.com/news/1411703/megan-fox-gives-birth-to-baby-with-machine-gun-kelly).

Days later, MGK [shaved](https://www.eonline.com/news/1416292/machine-gun-kelly-debuts-new-mustache-look-that-even-surprised-himself) his growing-a-beard-till-he-finished-his-new-album facial hair and then, on April 20, he performed a half-hour solo set in Las Vegas that _started_ at 1:45 a.m.

So, geographically speaking, MGK is out there once again, and way past his kids' bedtime.

"This is my first night out of the house since I had my beautiful daughter," MGK [told a packed house](https://www.reviewjournal.com/entertainment/entertainment-columns/kats/machine-gun-kelly-cuts-loose-with-razor-blade-guitar-in-nightclub-return-3354192/?utm_campaign=widget&utm_medium=columnist&utm_source=homepage&utm_term=Machine%20Gun%20Kelly%20cuts%20loose%20with%20razor-blade%20guitar%20in%20nightclub%20return) at LIV Nightclub in the Fontainebleau hotel, where he hit the stage for Wrestlemania After Dark. (And that very well could be true: Coachella was a daytime slot.)

The artist born **Colton Baker**, who shared some videos from his Vegas appearance to his Instagram Story, looked to be in his element. "I love making beats live," he captioned one clip, while in another he "took em back to 2012" with his rendition of "Wild Boy."

The father of two—he shares 15-year-old daughter **Casie** with ex **Emma Cannon**—had been busy in recent weeks indulging his combative side, [trading barbs with Fox's ex-husband **Brian Austin Green**](https://www.eonline.com/news/1415753/machine-gun-kelly-and-brian-austin-greens-feud-heats-up).

But he's also been posting scenes from his domestic idyll, including [the new chicken coop](https://www.eonline.com/news/1415939/machine-gun-kellys-new-home-addition-after-welcoming-baby) in his yard (because even celebrities don't want to spend a fortune on supermarket eggs).

Machine Gun Kelly/Instagram

"Dad," he [captioned an April 8 carousel of photos](https://www.eonline.com/news/1415859/mgk-shares-dad-photos-after-baby-with-megan-fox) that included a snap with Casie, another with Barker, a shot of the girl-dad-pink beverage tumbler he was holding while behind the wheel of his Rolls Royce and a selfie taken in a sparsely appointed walk-in closet.

"Welcome to the club again my brother," Barker—a father of four, including 17-month-old son **Rocky** with wife **Kourtney Kardashian**—commented on MGK's post.

Vivien Killilea/Getty Images for GQ

Once Kardashian and Barker got together in 2021, they made for a [loved-up foursome on occasional double dates](https://www.eonline.com/news/1328632/megan-foxs-revelation-about-double-dating-with-kourtney-kardashian-and-travis-barker-may-surprise-you) with Fox and MGK, who were mostly _on_ for the better part of four years before [breaking up](https://www.eonline.com/news/1409971/pregnant-megan-fox-and-machine-gun-kelly-break-up) (for good, for now) in December.

MGK is at least tight as ever with Barker, the pair even [collaborating on music](https://www.eonline.com/news/1415388/travis-barker-played-role-in-megan-fox-mgk-babys-birth) that would be the first his newborn heard upon arrival. "We composed the score of the birth," MGK shared afterward. "What an epic journey. Praise God."

Two weeks after [Fox's Nov. 11 pregnancy announcement](https://www.eonline.com/news/1404500/megan-fox-is-pregnant-expecting-baby-with-machine-gun-kelly) and 15 days before [news of their breakup](https://www.eonline.com/news/1409971/pregnant-megan-fox-and-machine-gun-kelly-break-up) surfaced, MGK shared he had embarked on a different sort of journey to clear his head. The goal was to get his seventh studio album done, finally, after scrapping what he'd _been_ working on [for the second time](https://www.instagram.com/p/DIj7BLDz79i/?img_index=8).

"Isolating myself in the desert next week to restart this album from scratch," he [posted to X Nov. 25](https://x.com/machinegunkelly/status/1861196728247914572?s=46&t=r5_SxrLpuGysSUK5FN6nZg). "When inspiration flows through me unblocked, we will reach the destination in no time. don't worry...After all, im about to be a dad again!"

MGK continued to lean into that spiritual life as he and Fox awaited the birth. On Feb. 3 he shared a photo showing his journal and a copy of **Paulo Coelho**'s 1988 allegory _The_ _Alchemist_, which he was reading "for the 4th time."

A couple weeks later, [church was "right on time" for MGK](https://www.eonline.com/news/1413582/machine-gun-kelly-shares-rare-message-about-his-and-pregnant-megan-foxs-baby-after-breakup), who shared a shot of the pulpit and a screen with the projected message: "Your past is not your purpose—your priority is ahead of you."

Machine Gun Kelly/Instagram

But MGK is no stranger to self-reflection and doing the work.

"Mentally, for me, seven years ago I was on cocaine and any drug you could imagine. And that isn't the case anymore," he said on an August episode of [**Logan Paul**'s _Impaulsive_ podcast](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ml-6cpB51iM&t=5s). "So when you say, like, I come across \[as\] grounded, that's a new revelation for me and a new version of myself I just met."

By then, Fox had [played his pregnant significant other](https://www.eonline.com/news/1405443/megan-fox-plays-the-role-of-a-pregnant-woman-in-machine-gun-kellys-new-music-video) in the music video for his song "Lonely Road," and Paul asked MGK if she really was expecting.

"I like to leave a lot of stuff up to interpretation and there’s a reason behind every single thing that happened in that music video," MGK said. "Some part of me is like, leave art up to interpretation, I guess that’s where I’ll leave it. But everything has a meaning."

Seven months after that episode dropped, MGK announced his daughter's arrival.

"She’s finally here!!" MGK captioned a March 27 video of their daughter's teeny-tiny hand clutching his thumb. "our little celestial seed." (Naturally, people then wondered if they had named her "Celestial Seed," which he [swiftly debunked](https://www.eonline.com/news/1415547/megan-fox-machine-gun-kelly-baby-name-mgk-addresses-rumor), advising that Fox would share the baby's name when she was ready.)

This is baby No. 4 for Fox, 38, who shares **Noah**, 12, **Bodhi**,11, and **Journey**, 8, with Green.

Meanwhile, the _Transformers_ star has exercised her right to remain private in recent weeks, [an April 18 trip to the grocery store with MGK](https://www.eonline.com/news/1416339/megan-fox-machine-gun-kellys-first-outing-since-welcoming-baby) in Calabasas, Calif., the first sighting of her since she gave birth.

Matt Winkelmeyer/Getty Images for MRC

Despite having no qualms about [discussing her intense feelings for MGK](https://www.eonline.com/news/1209681/megan-fox-details-how-she-saves-boyfriend-mgk-from-his-self-destructive-tendencies) during the earlier days of their relationship, Fox—who shared in 2023 that she had [suffered a pregnancy loss with him](https://www.eonline.com/news/1389407/megan-fox-shares-she-suffered-miscarriage-while-pregnant-with-her-and-machine-gun-kellys-baby)—has since changed her approach.

Not least because explaining what was going on with them at [every twist and turn along the way](https://www.eonline.com/news/1213685/inside-megan-fox-and-machine-gun-kellys-achingly-beautiful-romance) just got too complicated.

"I think that what I've learned from being in this relationship is that it's not for public consumption," she [said on a March 2024 episode of _Call Her Daddy_](https://www.eonline.com/news/1397678/megan-foxs-call-her-daddy-bombshells-brian-austin-green-machine-gun-kelly-more). "So I think as of now, I don't have a comment on, like, the status of the relationship. What I can say is, that is what I refer to as being my 'twin soul,' and there will always be a tether to him no matter what."

That there will be, though her name is _not_ Celestial Seed.

Meanwhile, see more stars who have welcomed babies in 2025:

Elsie Hewitt/Instagram

Pete Davidson & Elsie Hewitt


------------------------------

Meet the heir of Staten Island! The comedian [welcomed his first child](https://www.eonline.com/news/1421034/pete-davidson-elsie-hewitt-first-baby-born)—a baby girl [named **Scottie Rose Hewitt Davidson**](https://www.eonline.com/news/1426372/pete-davidsons-baby-girl-named-after-dad-scott-davidson)—with the _Industry_ actress on Dec. 12.

Debby Ryan/Instagram

Debby Ryan & Josh Dun


-----------------------

The former _Jessie_ star [delievered her first baby](https://www.eonline.com/news/1422942/debby-ryan-josh-dun-welcome-baby) with the **Twenty One Pilots** singer during a intimate home birth. On Dec. 13, she announced that the couple named their baby girl **Felix Winter Dun**.

Instagram/Cheyenne Floyd

27 / 500

Cheyenne Floyd & Zach Davis






---------------------------------------------

The _Teen Mom_ star and her husband [welcomed their second baby together](https://www.eonline.com/news/1416427/The%20now-mom%20of%20three%20and%20husband%C2%A0Zach%20Davis%C2%A0welcomed%20their%20second%20baby%20together%C2%A0on%20Dec.%2010,%20the%C2%A0Teen%20Mom%C2%A0star%C2%A0shared%20on%20Instagram.%C2%A0%20%20This%20exciting%20news%20comes%20after%20the%20pair%E2%80%94who%20tied%20the%20knot%20in%202022%E2%80%94celebrated%20their%20pregnancy%20in%20a%20touching%C2%A0Instagram%C2%A0video%20with%20children,%C2%A0Ace,%204,%20and%C2%A0Ryder,%C2%A08.%C2%A0%20%20%E2%80%9CAnd%20when%20we%20had%20nothing%20to%20give,%20we%20surrendered%20it%20all%20to%20God.%20We%20told%20Him%20we%20couldn%E2%80%99t%20carry%20it%20anymore-and%20He%20answered,%E2%80%9D%20the%20duo%20captioned%20their%20joint%20video.%20%E2%80%9CNot%20our%20timing%20but%20His.%20This%20little%20life%20is%20proof%20that%20even%20in%20the%20waiting,%20even%20in%20the%20heartbreak,%20miracles%20are%20still%20being%20written.%E2%80%9D) on Dec. 10. The newborn joins older siblings **Ryder** and **Ace**.

AFF-USA/Shutterstock

Vanessa Hudgens & Cole Tucker


-------------------------------

The Disney Channel alum confirmed [she welcomed her second baby](https://www.eonline.com/news/1420518/vanessa-hudgens-gives-birth-welcomes-baby-with-cole-tucker) with the MLB star in an Nov. 29 Instagram post.

"Well…. I did it. Had another baby!!!" she wrote on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/vanessahudgens/p/DRp9ZSykgVF/) alongside a photo of herself in her hospital bed, holding hands with Cole. "What a wild ride labor is. Big shout out to all the moms. It’s truly incredible what our bodies can do."

Matt Baron/BEI/Shutterstock

Ioan Gruffudd & Bianca Wallace


--------------------------------

The couple had a fantastic Thanksgiving update as Ioan and Bianca shared that they had welcomed daugther **Mila Mae Gruffudd** on Nov. 2, 2025, one month before her original due date.

“Completely and totally in love with our tiny little angel," they wrote in a joint Instagram post. "Extremely grateful this thanksgiving.”

Ben Savage/Instagram

Ben Savage & Tessa Angermeier


-------------------------------

Baby meets world. The _Boy Meets World_ alum announced the arrival of his and his wife's baby girl in November 2025, writing in an Instagram post, "Welcome little one."

Axelle/Bauer-Griffin/FilmMagic

Tori Kelly & André Murillo


----------------------------

The singer [gave birth to her first baby](https://www.eonline.com/news/1421505/tori-kelly-gives-birth-to-first-baby-with-husband-andre-murillo?query=baby), a boy named **Zayden Michael Murillo**, with her husband of seven years on Nov. 11. Tori [announced the birth](https://www.instagram.com/p/DRI9AE6kYiK/?img_index=1) of her new bundle of joy on Nov. 17, leaving an adorable note for her son, “We love you so much, sweet boy.”

Instagram

Jesse Bongiovi & Jesse Light


------------------------------

[**Jon Bon Jovi**](https://www.eonline.com/news/1422842/jon-bon-jovi-on-millie-bobby-brown-jake-bongiovis-baby)’s oldest son and his wife, Jesse, announced that they [welcomed their first baby](https://www.eonline.com/news/1424883/jon-bon-jovis-son-jesse-bongiovi-jesse-light-welcome-baby?query=baby), a daughter named **Blair Lucy Bongiovi**, on Nov. 10. “Our sweet girl has arrived, and we couldn’t be happier,” the couple wrote on an [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DQ4h5jSEejt/) post announcing their newest addition. “Welcome to the world, baby Blair bear.”

Nathaniel S. Butler/NBAE via Getty Images

Cardi B & Stefon Diggs


------------------------

The Grammy Award-winning rapper and football star [announced the birth of their first baby together](https://www.eonline.com/news/1424657/cardi-b-welcomes-baby-boy-with-stefon-diggs?query=baby) on Nov. 13.

"Starting over is never easy but it’s been so worth it," Cardi—also mom to **Kulture**, **Wave** and **Blossom** with ex **Offset**—wrote on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DRBId3TDIGt/) after welcoming her new bundle of joy. “I brought new music and a new album to the world! A new baby into my world, and one more reason to be the best version of me, one more reason to love me more than anything else or anyone else so I can continue giving my babies the love and life they deserve."

Matt Baron/BEI/Shutterstock

Chris Evans & Alba Baptista


-----------------------------

The _Captain_ _America_ star and _Borderline_ actress [welcomed their first baby in late October](https://www.eonline.com/news/1420350/chris-evans-alba-baptista-welcome-baby?query=baby), [multiple outlets](https://people.com/chris-evans-welcomes-first-baby-with-alba-baptista-8406270) confirmed. Although the couple prefers to keep their personal lives private, Chris shed some light on his relationship with Alba before welcoming their bundle of joy.

"We're laying low,” [he told E! News](https://www.eonline.com/news/1418456/chris-evans-on-marriage-to-alba-baptista) in June.  “We're enjoying our time, just relaxing.”

Chelsea Lauren/Shutterstock

Kelsey Grammer & Kayte Walsh


------------------------------

The _Frasier_ star and his wife Kayte [welcomed their fourth baby together and his eighth overall](https://www.eonline.com/news/1423674/francesca-eastwood-gives-birth-to-baby-no-2), a son named **Christopher**, in October. "It was like three days ago," Kelsey told cohosts **Danielle Fishel**, **Will Friedle** and **Rider Strong** during the Oct. 27 episode of their [_Pod Meets World_ podcast](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/kelsey-grammer-meets-world/id1629908611?i=1000733683344). "Christopher's just joined the family.”

John Salangsang/Shutterstock

Vanessa Kirby & Paul Rabil


----------------------------

The _Fantastic Four_ actress and her longtime boyfriend [introduced their first child to the world](https://www.eonline.com/news/1422220/vanessa-kirby-gives-birth-to-first-baby-with-paul-rabil?query=baby) on Oct. 20. "I’m learning that becoming a parent slows you down and wakes you up at the same time," the lacrosse player wrote alongside an [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DP_iVQmDO9D/?hl=en&img_index=1) post featuring photos of their newborn. “That I’m really grateful for everyone’s health, that I get to wake up everyday to mum’s enormous love, and that we get to have you in our lives now.”

Tommaso Boddi/Getty Images for Clarins

Nara & Lucky Blue Smith


-------------------------

The TikToker shared that she gave [birth to her and her husband’s fourth baby](https://www.eonline.com/news/1418666/nara-smith-lucky-blue-smith-welcome-baby-no-4) on Oct. 11. [Known for their creative baby names](https://www.eonline.com/news/1424010/what-nara-smith-almost-named-her-fourth-baby), the couple—also parents to **Rumble Honey**, **Slim Easy** and **Whimsy Lou**, continued the tradition by naming their third daughter **Fawnie Golden Smith**.

Francesca Eastwood/Instagram

Francesca Eastwood & Alexander Wraith


---------------------------------------

The daughter of [**Clint Eastwood**](https://www.google.com/search?client=safari&rls=en&q=Clint+Eastwood+e+online&ie=UTF-8&oe=UTF-8) [welcomed her and her longtime partner’s second baby](https://www.eonline.com/news/1423674/francesca-eastwood-gives-birth-to-baby-no-2) on Oct. 10. Francesca’s [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DPoZJU1EYwk/) post announcing the news featured their eldest son **Titan Wraith** doting over the family’s new addition.

Instagram

Lauren Speed & Cameron Hamilton


---------------------------------

The _Love Is Blind_ season one stars [welcomed their first baby together](https://www.eonline.com/news/1418529/love-is-blinds-lauren-speed-cameron-hamilton-have-first-baby?query=baby), a boy named **Ezra William Hamilton**, on Oct. 1. "To God be the GLORY!" Lauren shared on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DQC6nZfj1Vm/?hl=en&img_index=1), explaining that Ezra arrived "a little earlier than planned, but perfectly on God’s time."

Mike Wulf/CSM/Shutterstock

Cam Newton & Jasmin Brown


---------------------------

The former NFL quarterback revealed on _The Tamron Hall Show_ in October that his girlfriend—with whom he welcomed a daughter in March 2024—had [given birth to their son](https://www.eonline.com/news/1423598/nfls-cam-newton-has-baby-no-9-second-with-jasmin-brown), making him a dad to nine kids.

Priscilla Robertson/Instagram

Priscilla Robertson & Dillon Nash


-----------------------------------

The _Duck Dynasty_ star [welcomed her first baby](https://www.eonline.com/news/1423551/duck-dynastys-priscilla-robertson-gives-birth) with her boyfriend on Oct. 6. Dillon gushed in [an Instagram post at the time](https://www.instagram.com/p/DPjSrcBjl8s/), "I am so blessed to be able to take care of this beautiful little girl and do it with the love of my life."

Instagram/Carlin Bates

Carlin Bates & Evan Stewart


-----------------------------

The _Bringing Up Bates_ couple [brought home their third baby](https://www.eonline.com/news/1422407/carlin-bates-gives-birth-welcomes-baby-with-evan-stewart), a girl. As Carlin [wrote on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DObbFpMEWkv/) Sept. 10, "The world just got a little softer."

Dave Allocca/Starpix/Shutterstock

Saoirse Ronan & Jack Lowden


-----------------------------

The pair debuted their first baby during a walk in London in September.

Joshua Kushner / Instagram

Karlie Kloss & Joshua Kushner


-------------------------------

The supermodel and her husband welcomed their third baby, a baby girl, on Sept. 18.

Joshua shared the news on social media Sept. 20 with an adorable photo of the newborn swaddled in a striped blanket and wearing a pink hat.

And in the [Instagram caption](https://www.instagram.com/p/DO2AmoLDwo3/), he revealed their baby girl’s name by writing, “**Rae Florence** 9.18.2025.”

Instagram/Erin Bates

Erin Bates & Chad Paine


-------------------------

The _Bringing Up Bates_ star and her husband **Chad Paine** welcomed their seventh child—a son named **Henry**—on Aug. 25. However, Erin was soon [admitted into the ICU for childbirth complications](https://www.eonline.com/news/1421881/erin-bates-bringing-up-bates-alum-in-septic-shock-after-giving-birth).

"Labor was longer and more intense than previous births,"  Chad [shared on Instagram Sept. 1](https://www.instagram.com/p/DOEG7MQjR9u/?img_index=1). "Erin developed a severe UTI and kidney infection, which sent her into septic shock."

Kevin Mazur/Getty Images

Riley Keough & Ben Smith-Peterson


-----------------------------------

**[Priscilla Presley](https://www.eonline.com/news/priscilla_presley)**, who was married to **[Elvis Presley](https://www.eonline.com/news/elvis_presley)** for six years until their 1973 divorce, revealed that her granddaughter and her husband privately welcomed their second baby.

“That’s what makes me happy,” Priscilla told _[People](https://people.com/priscilla-presley-details-taking-lisa-marie-off-life-support-exclusive-11811453)_ of her flourishing family in an interview published Sept. 17, “knowing everyone is doing well.”

Dia Dipasupil/Getty Images

Millie Bobby Brown & Jake Bongiovi


------------------------------------

The _Stranger Things_ star and son of **Jon Bon Jovi** revealed they [welcomed their first baby](https://www.eonline.com/news/1421465/millie-bobby-brown-jake-bon-jovi-adopt-baby?query=millie) one year after getting married.

"This summer, we welcomed our sweet baby girl through adoption," the couple wrote in an Aug. 21 Instagram post. "We are beyond excited to embark on this beautiful next chapter of parenthood in both peace and privacy."

They concluded, "And then there were 3."

Instagram/Nell Hudson

Nell Hudson & Max King


------------------------

On Aug. 6, the _Outlander_ alum announced that she [gave birth](https://www.eonline.com/news/1420854/nell-hudson-gives-birth-welcomes-baby-with-husband-max-king) to her and her producer husband's first baby, a daughter.

(Photo by Steve Granitz/FilmMagic)

Miguel & Margaret Zhang


-------------------------

The “Sure Thing” singer shared that he and his partner privately welcomed their first baby in 2024 in a tribute post for the little one’s first birthday.

“Our baby turned 1 today,” Miguel [wrote on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DOXzw2NDnUl/) Sept. 9 alongside a video of him and his baby, whose face is blurred out. “HAPPY BIRTHDAY ANGELITO!!!”

“We love you so much,” he continued. “So proud and honored that you chose us to be your parents. Papá wrote you a song—hope it always reminds you of how loved you are.”

Dia Dipasupil/Getty Images

Thomas Kail & Michelle Williams


---------------------------------

In August, the _Dawson's Creek_ alum confirmed she is now the mom to "three under 5," with husband **Thomas Kail** on top of her teenager **Matilda** she shares with the late **Heath Ledger**.

"This last baby did not come through my body," Michelle joked of welcoming her latest bundle of joy via surrogate during an appearance on _Jimmy Kimmel Live!_ "but the miracle of our little girl is thanks to Christine."

Photo by Samir Hussein/WireImage

Calvin Harris & Vick Hope


---------------------------

The DJ and the British radio personality [welcomed their first baby](https://www.eonline.com/news/1420705/calvin-harris-wife-vick-hope-welcome-first-baby) together, a boy named **Micah**, on July 20.

"My wife is a superhero and I am in complete awe of her primal wisdom," Calvin wrote on Instagram Aug. 4. "Just so grateful. We love you so much Micah."

Instagram/Guaynaa

Lele Pons & Guaynaa


---------------------

The influencer and the rapper welcomed their first baby together, a girl named **Eloísa**, on July 26.

Trisha Paytas/Instagram

Trisha Paytas & Moses Hacmon


------------------------------

The YouTuber announced that she and her husband [welcomed their third and "final" baby](https://www.eonline.com/news/1420139/trisha-paytas-gives-birth-welcomes-baby-no-3) on July 12.

She also unveiled their son's super powerful name—**Aquaman Moses Paytas-Hacmon**—by revealing a bedazzled T-shirt of the DC comic book character.

Gilbert Flores/Golden Globes 2024/Golden Globes 2024 via Getty Images

Wilmer Valderrama & Amanda Pacheco


------------------------------------

The _NCIS_ star and his fiancée [welcomed their second child](https://www.eonline.com/news/1420100/wilmer-valderrama-amanda-pacheco-welcome-baby-no-2), a baby boy, who joined his big sister **Nakano Oceana**.

“**Wolf Monte Valderrama**,” the pair wrote on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DMTysauSc3t/?igsh=bXFoMW53dXZvaHg3&img_index=4) July 20. “7/11/2025.”

Opening a restaurant or a nightclub in 2023 is an act of faith. The hospitality business is facing challenges, including rising costs, staffing issues, unforeseen delays and a world where everything from delivery apps to streaming entertainment makes staying home more exciting. Plus, workloads are often high, while margins are often low.

The men and women on Observer’s 2023 Dining and Nightlife Power List are believers. They believe in the restorative power of hospitality and in both the tangible and intangible rewards that come with that. They believe that restaurants and nightclubs can make guests feel more alive. They believe that hospitality can be a platform that leads to multiple venues and multiple revenue streams.

For the people on this list, it’s not enough to have just one restaurant or nightclub. It’s about a financial and cultural impact in multiple neighborhoods or cities (including New York City, the Hamptons, Los Angeles, Las Vegas, Miami, Dallas and Aspen), or it’s about diversifying into products, media, events, technology and other businesses. It’s also about creating an ecosystem that encourages and empowers employees to chase their own hospitality dreams. It’s about the feeling of crushing and drowning every day, about juggling multiple roles and finding ways to thrive or at least survive, so you can do it again the next day and the next and the next.

Here are the power players setting the table for the future of the hospitality industry.

*   [Kevin Hart](https://observer.com/list/nightlife-dining-power-list-2023/#kevin-hart)
*   [Eric Demby and Jonathan Butler](https://observer.com/list/nightlife-dining-power-list-2023/#eric-demby-and-jonathan-butler)

Mario Carbone, Rich Torrisi & Jeff Zalaznick
--------------------------------------------

*   **Major Food Group**

It might seem crazy that [a 10-year-old restaurant](https://observer.com/2013/04/food-court-carbone-makes-a-case-for-the-greatness-of-the-red-sauce-joint/) is still the hottest restaurant in the country. But it should be clear by now that Major Food Group operates on another level. According to data obtained by Observer_,_ New York’s Carbone has the most Resy notifications (upwards of 20,000 a week) of any restaurant in America. And there have been weeks where the restaurant with the second-most notifications has been New York’s new Torrisi Bar & Restaurant, [the triumphant rebirth of the brand that started it all](https://observer.com/2012/01/torrisi-italian-specialties-profile-01242012/2/) for Major Food Group’s game-changing visionaries.

There are now more than 50 Major Food Group restaurants worldwide, including those in the hospitality company’s Miami private club. The $3,000-per-seat Carbone Beach pop-ups, presented by American Express, have attracted [A-list crowds during Miami’s Formula One](https://observer.com/2023/05/at-f1-miami-and-kentucky-derby-food-is-a-big-part-of-the-spectacle/) week. A members-only ZZ’s Club, which will feature the world’s first private Carbone, has sold out of $50,000 founding memberships and is scheduled to open later this year at Hudson Yards.

“We’re in the process of expanding not only our incredible restaurant portfolio but expanding into other verticals,” Zalaznick tells Observer, mentioning hotel deals like The Newbury Boston as well as branded residential developments like a forthcoming Major Food Group condo tower in Miami. “We’re not stopping. We’re creating better products than ever and really growing and spreading our wings across the entirety of the hospitality world."

![Image 1](https://observer.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2023/09/Jeff-Zalaznick-Mario-Carbone-Rich-Torrisi-in-the-Miami-Design-District.jpg?quality=80&w=970)

Jeff Zalaznick, Mario Carbone, Rich Torrisi in the Miami Design District. Camilo Rios

******************************************************************Junghyun and Ellia Park******************************************************************
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **************************************************Na:eun Hospitality**************************************************

A decade after this married couple immigrated to New York, the Parks have found themselves at the absolute pinnacle of fine dining with Atomix. Yes, the top-ranked United States restaurant in this year’s World’s 50 Best List is a unicorn with evocative tasting menus that showcase Korean traditions, techniques and artisans. Junghyun, who goes by JP and won a 2023 James Beard Award for Best Chef: New York, is proud to shatter stereotypes and show guests that Korean cuisine is about much more than barbecue, spicy food, noodles and free banchan. Atomix is here to help redefine and revalue Korean food.

“I believe the next generation can change what fine dining means,” JP tells Observer. “It’s going to be more personal. It needs to be more about their own stories.”

The Parks also operate their first restaurant, Atoboy, which playfully merges Korean food and New York influences. And they’ve joined the formidable new dining collection at Rockefeller Center with the recent opening of Naro, which is inspired by classic Korean dishes that are underrepresented in America.

“We have so many Korean-Americans and immigrants working with us, and they said they found their identity at our restaurants,” Ellia says. “That’s what’s most important for us.”

To cite just one example: After cooking at Atomix, chef Ki Kim moved to Los Angeles and opened Kinn. The headline for Kinn’s _Los Angeles Times_ review asked a question with an answer that was self-evident: “[Is this Koreatown upstart the future of fine dining in L.A.?](https://www.latimes.com/food/story/2023-05-18/kinn-koreatown-tasting-menu-bill-addison-review)”

![Image 2](https://observer.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2023/10/Junghyun-and-Ellia-Park.jpg?quality=80&w=970)

Junghyun and Ellia Park. Peter Ash Lee

**********************************************Chintan Pandya and Roni Mazumdar**********************************************
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   ****************************Unapologetic Foods****************************

These happy rebels, who specialize in uncompromising, obscure, hyper-specific Indian food, have created some of New York’s most popular restaurants and are just getting started.

“The day we feel that our story is told across all corners of America is probably the day we will stop,” Mazumdar tells Observer. “A lot of people start with the real estate. We start with the emotion.”

Their growing restaurant portfolio includes Dhamaka, Semma (chef Vijay Kumar’s Michelin-starred hot spot which has about a 1,500-person waiting list daily), Masalawala & Sons (a restaurant that has proven that the demand for their food in Brooklyn rivals what they’ve seen in Manhattan) and the fast-casual Rowdy Rooster. They sell upwards of 900 pounds of lamb and goat (including, famously, goat kidneys and testicles at Dhamaka) on busy weeks. They have plans to open three more New York restaurants in the coming months.

“We are very lucky because we have a population of 1.4 billion in our country and the food changes every 50, 60 miles,” Pandya says. “So we have this big, blank whiteboard in front of us.”

And they’re not limiting themselves to Indian cuisine. One of their forthcoming restaurants, Naks, will serve Filipino food.

![Image 3](https://observer.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2023/10/Chintan-Pandya-and-Roni-Mazumdar.jpg?quality=80&w=970)

Chintan Pandya and Roni Mazumdar. Clay Williams

****************************************************Johann Moonesinghe and Andrew Harris****************************************************
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   ********************************inKind********************************

The married couple behind the country’s most innovative restaurant-financing company have deployed upwards of $120 million to more than 1,000 restaurants. This includes funding  expansion for hall-of-famers like Danny Meyer, José Andrés and Michael Mina and dominant hospitality companies like Major Food Group, Noble 33 and 50 Eggs. Instead of giving loans or taking equity, inKind pre-purchases food-and-beverage credit and sells it on its app. It also provides marketing, mentorship and access to a coveted 450,000-plus user base that tends to rack up higher check averages and return more often than other customers.

“The typical restaurant-financing model is broken,” Moonesinghe tells Observer. “A lot of chefs and restaurateurs walk away from their busy restaurants because it’s very difficult to pay back investors and make money. So we created a better way.”

![Image 4](https://observer.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2023/10/Andy-Johann-Cancun.jpg?quality=80&w=970)

Johann Moonesinghe and Andrew Harris. Courtesy of inKind Capital

******************************************************************************************Jeffrey Soffer******************************************************************************************
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   ********************************************************************************Fontainebleau Development********************************************************************************

In December, Miami real estate titan Soffer will open the highly anticipated 3,644-room Fontainebleau Las Vegas casino-resort with [36 food-and-beverage venues](https://observer.com/2023/09/fontainebleau-vegas-opening-celebrity-chefs-debut/), including the first Vegas spots from Mexico City powerhouse chef Gabriela Camara, prolific Miami operator [David Grutman](https://observer.com/person/david-grutman/ "David Grutman"), Los Angeles pasta overlord Evan Funke and New York sushi stars Masa Ito and Kevin Kim .

“It is a dream come true to see this project come to fruition after 15 years,” Soffer tells Observer. “For Fontainebleau, this evolution of our brand and expansion to an incredible destination like Las Vegas is a testament to a legacy that dates back to 1954 and the opening of Fontainebleau Miami Beach. This is our moment to show the world and our guests what Fontainebleau Development does best. We are creating an extension of the iconic Fontainebleau experience, with its remarkable history, culture, design and service embedded within its walls.”

Soffer, who reacquired the Fontainebleau Las Vegas building in 2021 and managed to secure a $2.2 billion loan to complete the resort, also continues to invest heavily in Miami. He’s putting nearly $100 million into the revamp of Fontainebleau Miami Beach, which will include a state-of-the-art 50,000-square-foot event center that is slated to open in 2025. And in a partnership of real estate heavyweights, Fontainebleau Development and Related Companies are working together to build a new Westin hotel at Miami International Airport.

![Image 5](https://observer.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2023/10/Jeff-Soffer.jpg?quality=80&w=970)

Jeffrey Soffer. Melanie Dunea

****************************************************************************Enrique Olvera and Santiago Perez****************************************************************************
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   ******************************************************************Casamata******************************************************************

With 17 restaurants, Olvera and Perez have brought top-tier ingredients like heirloom corn and sustainable seafood to the masses. They operate both high-end contemporary Mexican restaurants like Mexico City’s Pujol, New York’s Cosme and L.A.’s Damian as well as a growing group of more casual spots.

Atla, an “everyday Mexican” restaurant that started in New York, recently expanded to Los Angeles with the opening of a breezy 7,200-square-foot Venice space that Olvera thinks could be a prototype for future restaurants. A new taqueria, Tacos Atla, will debut in Williamsburg this year. But Olvera and Perez are also growing beyond the Atla brand and have plans for two other New York restaurants and another Mexico City spot next year.

“We have two efforts going on: further building the Atla brand, which is a lot more replicable, and   the other one is one-off fine dining,” Perez says. “We really want to further build our presence both in New York and Mexico City, which at the moment are our largest markets. Depending on how the taqueria and the Atla sit-down concept work, we’re going to push the accelerator a little further.”

Casamata already goes through close to a ton of masa (and an average of 2,000 tortillas per restaurant) every day.

![Image 6](https://observer.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2023/10/Enrique-Olvera-and-Santiago-Perez.png?w=970&quality=80)

Enrique Olvera and Santiago Perez. Araceli Paz

************************************************Jeff Klein************************************************
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   ******************************JK Hotel Group******************************

[Jeff Klein](https://observer.com/person/jeff-klein/ "Jeff Klein") is known for Sunset Tower and San Vicente Bungalows (a private club that, contrary to rumors, has not kicked out Prince Harry and Meghan Markle) in Los Angeles. But Klein, who was born and raised in New York, plans to open what feels like his crown jewel next spring in the West Village.

“This is probably the most exciting thing in my career,” Klein tells Observer. His previous New York ventures included City Club and Graydon Carter’s Monkey Bar.

Klein’s purchased the Jane Hotel for $62 million and will likely spend close to that amount reimagining the space as a 100-room hotel and the separate San Vicente West Village membership club. The private club will include nine luxurious guest rooms, a dinner-only dining room, a lush rooftop cafe for lunch, a basement discotheque, a screening room, event spaces and co-working. Klein is also busy in L.A., where San Vicente Santa Monica will likely open around the same time next year.

“If you’re a member of one, you have the opportunity to be a member of all of them,” Klein says.

He looks for “diversity in every sense of the word” and an even split of women and men as he creates private spaces for people who actively contribute to the creative culture and also the professional and philanthropic worlds.

“We reject a lot of billionaires,” Klein says. “Just because someone has money doesn’t make them interesting.”

![Image 7](https://observer.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2023/10/Jeff-Klein.jpg?quality=80&w=970)

Jeff Klein. Kendrick Brinson

************************************************************************Jerry Greenberg************************************************************************
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **********************************************************Sushi Nozawa Group**********************************************************

**************************************************************Chris Webb**************************************************************
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   ********************************************ChowNow********************************************

When Webb launched ChowNow in 2012, his goal was to simply offer independent restaurants an online ordering solution. Since then, the subscription-based commission-free takeout platform (which gives restaurants all customer data from transactions) has become vital for multiple reasons. Most importantly, the simple idea of letting restaurants keep more money from each sale helps operators survive in a challenging industry that only became harder when Covid-19 hit.

A commission-free platform also reduces the cost of takeout for customers because restaurants aren’t inclined to mark up prices as they do on apps that take percentages of each sale. Webb understands that many restaurants, desperate for revenue, signed up for multiple platforms during the pandemic. He sees ChowNow as a one-stop alternative now that things are normalizing.

“What we’ve always focused on is building one platform to power all things takeout,” Webb says. “You don’t need to use five vendors. We can take care of everything for you. You can have one button on your website for pickup and delivery.”

ChowNow works with 20,000 restaurants and saves those restaurants hundreds of millions of dollars in commissions each year. It’s powered more than 250 million orders from 45 million customers, including 15 million customers in the last year.
